domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Burnt Exhaust Valve on Cylinder #1 — Passes Spark & Fuel Tests
phContext: High-mileage LPG taxis, Honda L15/R18, Toyota 1NZ; tight valve lash
symptoms: Steady miss at idle that smooths slightly at 2500 RPM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Perform dry & wet compression test (0–400 kPa = dead cylinder; stays low wet = valve/head, rises wet = rings!). 2. Run cylinder leak-down test: air hissing out tailpipe confirms burnt exhaust valve!

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Blown Head Gasket Between Adjacent Cylinders (#2 & #3)
phContext: Overheated aluminum-head engines (Vios, City, Mirage, Innova)
symptoms: Dual misfire P0302+P0303, rhythmic popping in intake/exhaust
diagnosticSteps: 1. Run compression test: both #2 and #3 read identically low (e.g., 550 kPa) while #1 & #4 read 1250 kPa! 2. Pressurize #2 with leak-down air and feel air blowing out #3 spark plug hole!

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Hydraulic Lifter / Lash Adjuster Ticking — Aerated or Sludged Oil
phContext: Mitsubishi, Hyundai, Kia, Mazda with hydraulic lifters (HLA)
symptoms: Loud metallic top-end tap at cold start or hot idle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check oil level (overfilled oil whips into foam by crank!). 2. Measure mechanical oil pressure hot (low pressure starves HLAs). 3. Replace sludged oil + OEM filter or collapsed HLA.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Crankshaft Harmonic Balancer (Damper) Rubber Ring Separated
phContext: Older Toyota, Mitsubishi, Nissan, Honda; oil-soaked rubber damper
symptoms: Belt squeal, wobble at crank pulley, timing marks drift!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Paint a straight chalk line across inner hub, rubber ring, and outer pulley ring; run engine 10 sec and shut off: if chalk line splits, outer ring is slipping! 2. Replace crank pulley.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Excessive Crankcase Blow-By Pushing Oil Into Airbox
phContext: High-mileage diesels/gasoline engines; stuck-shut rings or broken ring land
symptoms: Air filter soaked in engine oil, dipstick pops up
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect PCV/breather hose at idle and check for heavy pulsing smoke. 2. Run cylinder leak-down test listening at oil filler neck (air hiss = worn piston rings). 3. Check PCV valve.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Rear Main Seal Oil Leak vs. Valve Cover / Oil Pan Drip
phContext: All high-mileage PH vehicles; oil dripping from bellhousing bottom
symptoms: Red/black oil drops under engine-transmission joint
diagnosticSteps: 1. Never pull transmission for Rear Main Seal before checking TOP of engine (valve cover rear corner, cam plug, or oil pressure sender often runs down back of block!). 2. Clean with brake cleaner + UV dye.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Stripped Spark Plug Threads / Loose Plug Blow-By
phContext: Aluminum-head engines where spark plugs were over-torqued hot
symptoms: Ticking/chuffing sound like exhaust leak, fuel smell, coil boot blown up
diagnosticSteps: 1. Listen around each coil pack with stethoscope tube; remove suspect coil and check if plug is finger-loose! 2. Install Time-Sert/Helicoil thread insert cleanly.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Broken Valve Spring — Sudden Dead Cylinder & Mechanical Clatter
phContext: High-RPM manual cars or fatigued high-mileage springs
symptoms: Sudden misfire + rhythmic metallic tap under valve cover
diagnosticSteps: 1. Perform relative compression test + vacuum gauge check (needle fluctuates wildly at idle). 2. Pull valve cover to inspect spring height & retainer! 3. Replace spring before valve drops.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Worn Camshaft Lobe — Flat Exhaust/Intake Lift
phContext: Engines starved of oil or with seized roller follower
symptoms: Popping back through intake or sluggish cylinder, zero misfire fix from coils/plugs
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure running compression vs. cranking compression (or intake vacuum pulse). 2. Pull valve cover and measure cam lobe height / inspect rocker rollers.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Oil Pressure Relief Valve Stuck Open — Zero Pressure Hot
phContext: Engines with debris jamming oil pump bypass plunger
symptoms: Red oil light on at hot idle AND at 2500 RPM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Attach mechanical oil pressure gauge immediately! 2. Inspect oil filter for collapsed media or metal glitter. 3. Remove/clean oil pump relief plunger & spring.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Cylinder Head Warpage After Overheat — Slow Combustion Leak
phContext: Cars driven 10 min into red temp zone in traffic
symptoms: Overflow bottle bubbles gently when revved, hoses rock-hard cold!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Squeeze upper radiator hose cold after overnight sit (rock-hard residual pressure = combustion leak!). 2. Run block-test blue fluid at radiator neck. 3. Skim head & replace gasket.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Piston Slap When Cold — Scuffed Skirt (Overheat / Low Oil)
phContext: High-mileage taxis/cars previously overheated
symptoms: Hollow knocking sound cold that quiets down once warmed to 85°C
diagnosticSteps: 1. Distinguish piston slap (loudest cold, fades hot) from rod knock (louder hot under light load/snap decel!). 2. Borescope cylinder walls for vertical scuffing.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Connecting Rod Bearing Knock — Spun Bearing (Oil Starvation)
phContext: Engines run low on oil or with clogged oil pickup screen
symptoms: Sharp metallic double-knock when snapping throttle to 2500 RPM & releasing
diagnosticSteps: 1. Perform cylinder balance/cutout test while snapping throttle (knock quiets down when faulty cylinder's spark/injector is cut!). 2. Drop oil pan to inspect copper/bronze shavings.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Crankshaft Thrust Bearing Play — Engine Stalls Pressing Clutch!
phContext: Manual pickups/cars where driver rides clutch at stoplights
symptoms: Engine RPM drops or stalls when pressing clutch pedal!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Watch front crank pulley while assistant presses clutch pedal: pulley moves forward >0.3 mm = worn crank thrust washer! 2. Also causes CKP air-gap dropout!

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Timing Belt Shredded by Seized Water Pump / Idler Bearing
phContext: Timing-belt engines (4D56, older Vios/Civic/Accent) with skipped pump service
symptoms: Engine shuts off silently while driving, cranks super fast ('freewheeling')
diagnosticSteps: 1. Listen to cranking sound (fast uneven spinning = no compression!). 2. Pull upper timing cover to check belt. 3. Borescope pistons for valve-contact marks (interference engine!).

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Freeze Plug / Core Plug Rusted Out — Hidden Coolant Leak
phContext: Older engines run on plain tap water instead of coolant
symptoms: Coolant pouring from behind flywheel or exhaust manifold
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pressurize cooling system cold and inspect brass/steel core plugs along block sides and rear bellhousing. 2. Replace rusted plug with brass core plug and switch to 50/50 coolant.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Intake Manifold Plastic Runner Flap Detached — Rattling Inside Plenum
phContext: Mazda/Ford/Hyundai composite intakes; loose swirl vane screw
symptoms: Loud plastic rattle at 2000 RPM, risk of screw entering cylinder!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Listen to intake plenum with stethoscope. 2. Remove intake manifold immediately to check swirl shaft screws/bushings before engine ingests metal!

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Oil Cooler Gasket Mixing Oil Into Coolant (No Head Gasket Fault!)
phContext: Pickups/SUVs/sedans with water-to-oil cooler at oil filter housing
symptoms: Thick black/brown oil sludge floating inside radiator neck (not milky oil in pan!)
diagnosticSteps: 1. Note: Oil pressure (300 kPa) > Coolant pressure (100 kPa), so failed oil cooler pushes OIL into RADIATOR, whereas head gasket often pushes coolant into oil! 2. Pressure-test oil cooler.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: PCV Valve Stuck Closed — Blown Cam/Crank Oil Seals
phContext: Neglected city cars; gummed PCV check ball
symptoms: Oil suddenly leaking from valve cover, cam seal, and dipstick at once
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull PCV valve and shake (must rattle cleanly) and verify engine vacuum pulls on hose at idle. 2. Replace clogged PCV valve before replacing oil seals!

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: PCV Valve Stuck Wide Open — High Oil Consumption & Lean Idle
phContext: High-mileage engines sucking oil mist straight into intake
symptoms: Blue smoke on takeoff after idling, P0171 lean code
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pinch PCV hose at idle: if idle drops/smooths out and vacuum hiss stops, PCV is stuck open! 2. Replace OEM PCV valve.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Valve Stem Seals Hardened — Blue Smoke Puff on Startup & Decel
phContext: 8+ year old gasoline/diesel engines in PH heat
symptoms: Puff of blue oil smoke after sitting 10 min or coasting downhill, clears quickly
diagnosticSteps: 1. Distinguish stem seals (smoke on startup/high-vacuum decel) from worn rings (continuous smoke under hard acceleration!). 2. Replace valve stem seals.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Sheared Crankshaft Keyway / Timing Gear Pin — Timing Drift
phContext: Engines where crank pulley bolt was under-torqued after belt job
symptoms: Erratic running, crank pulley wobbles, timing jumps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove crank pulley and inspect keyway slot on crank snout & timing sprocket for wallowing! 2. Repair keyway / replace sprocket & torque crank bolt with threadlocker.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Exhaust Manifold Studs Snapped — Loud Cold Tick That Quietens Hot
phContext: High-mileage pickups/SUVs; thermal expansion snapping rear stud
symptoms: Sharp ticking noise for first 2 min cold, disappears when warm
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect exhaust manifold corners for black soot streaks & missing bolt heads! 2. Extract broken stud and replace gasket.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Oil Filter Gasket Double-Gasketed — Massive Oil Blowout!
phContext: Cars right after quick oil change; old rubber ring stuck to block
symptoms: Entire 4L of engine oil dumps onto driveway within 30 seconds of startup!
diagnosticSteps: 1. ALWAYS verify old rubber filter O-ring came off with old filter and wipe mating land clean! 2. Check oil pressure light immediately at first startup.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Intake Vacuum Leak at Brake Booster Check Valve — Hard Brake + Rough Idle
phContext: Older cars; cracked plastic vacuum tee
symptoms: Rough idle + stiff brake pedal
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clamp booster hose briefly at idle: if rough idle smooths out instantly, leak is in booster/check valve! 2. Replace valve/hose.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Cylinder Wall Glazing / Stuck Oil Control Rings — High Oil Burn
phContext: Low-load crawling city cars with 15,000 km mineral oil intervals
symptoms: Burns 1 liter of oil every 1,000 km with no visible external leak
diagnosticSteps: 1. Borescope cylinder walls & inspect spark plug threads for wet oil. 2. Perform piston soak / compression test. 3. Overhaul rings if worn.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Timing Chain Guide Plastic Shattered — Oil Pan Clogged
phContext: High-mileage chain engines (Nissan YD25/QR25, Toyota 1NZ/1NR)
symptoms: Loud slapping noise from timing cover, low oil pressure
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect timing cover & drop oil pan to remove broken brown plastic guide chunks from oil pickup screen! 2. Replace full timing chain & guide kit.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Head Bolt Thread Pulled (Aluminum Block) — Recurring Gasket Blow
phContext: Engines overheated multiple times; stripped block deck threads
symptoms: Head gasket blows again 3 months after repair!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always check head-bolt hole threads in aluminum block and use NEW torque-to-yield (TTY) head bolts! 2. Install Time-Sert block thread inserts if stripped.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Wet Cylinder Liner / Block Cavitation Pitting (Heavy Diesel)
phContext: Commercial diesels run on plain water without SCA coolant additives
symptoms: Coolant slowly enters crankcase with intact head gasket
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pressurize cooling system with oil pan dropped and inspect bottom of cylinder liners for green coolant drips! 2. Replace pitted liners/O-rings and use heavy-duty OAT/SCA coolant.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Exhaust Valve Recession (LPG Taxis) — Zero Lash Compression Loss
phContext: LPG-converted Vios/Avanza/Innova running dry gaseous fuel
symptoms: Starts hard cold, stalls in traffic, rough idle
diagnosticSteps: 1. LPG burns hotter with zero valve-seat lubrication! Check valve clearances every 30,000 km. 2. Rebuild head with hardened stellite valve seats.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Oil Pan Dented Against Oil Pickup Screen — Starved Engine!
phContext: Low sedans hitting concrete curb/rock on provincial road
symptoms: Oil pressure light flickers on turns/braking, rod knock risk
diagnosticSteps: 1. Look under engine sump for upward dent directly below oil pickup bell! (Dent chokes off oil flow!). 2. Drop pan, replace/straighten pan & inspect pickup.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Injector Copper Seat Erosion ('Black Death' Carbon Crust)
phContext: CRDi diesels (Montero, Starex, Hilux, Ranger); leaking combustion seal
symptoms: Thick hard black tar crust around injector base, diesel fumes in cabin
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove valve/engine cover and inspect injector wells for black tar/chuffing! 2. Soak tar with solvent, re-cut cylinder head injector seat flat with seat-cutter tool, and install new copper washer.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Camshaft Position Reluctor Wheel Spun on Cam (Press-Fit)
phContext: Modern hollow-tube camshafts with pressed-on trigger wheel
symptoms: Sudden P0016/P0340 no-start despite intact timing chain!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify TDC piston #1 mechanically vs. cam lobes AND check cam trigger wheel alignment! 2. Replace camshaft if pressed reluctor ring slipped.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Intake Manifold Gasket Coolant Leak (V6/V8 / Wet Intake)
phContext: Engines where coolant passes through intake manifold end ports
symptoms: Coolant disappearing externally down bellhousing or into cylinders
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pressure-test system cold and inspect intake manifold valley corners for wet coolant. 2. Replace intake gasket set.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Flywheel Pilot Bearing Seized — Input Shaft Dragging in Neutral
phContext: Manual pickups/cars after flood or dry clutch job
symptoms: Hard to shift into 1st/Reverse even with clutch pressed to floor, screech
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always replace cheap pilot bearing/bushing in crankshaft rear center during clutch job! 2. Inspect transmission input shaft tip for scoring.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Oil Pressure Sending Unit Diaphragm Leak — Oil in Harness
phContext: Vehicles with 1-pin/3-pin oil pressure switch
symptoms: Oil light flickers, engine oil dripping out of wire loom!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug oil pressure switch; oil inside plastic plug confirms burst diaphragm! 2. Replace sender (check wiring if oil wicked up to ECM!).

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Spark Plug Electrode Melted — Wrong Heat Range / Lean Cylinder
phContext: Tuned or overheated gasoline engines
symptoms: Sudden dead cylinder, loss of compression
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect spark plug tip for blistered/melted ground strap (check fuel injector flow & cooling on that cylinder!). 2. Borescope piston crown for hole/detonation.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Water Pump Cavitation — Collapsed Lower Hose / Missing Spring
phContext: High-RPM engines with soft aged lower radiator hose
symptoms: Overheats only above 3500 RPM on highway
diagnosticSteps: 1. Rev engine to 3500 RPM while watching lower radiator hose (sucks flat like a straw!). 2. Replace lower hose with OEM spring-reinforced hose.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Rocker Arm / Follower Popped Off — High-RPM Over-Rev
phContext: Manual engines missed-shifted 5th→2nd
symptoms: Sudden dead cylinder, loud clatter under valve cover
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull valve cover and inspect all rocker arms/finger followers. 2. Check valve stem straightness & compression before reinstalling.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Crankcase Oil Dilution by Raw Fuel — Rich Injector / Short Trips
phContext: GDI & DPF diesel vehicles in short city hops
symptoms: Oil level rises 1–2 cm above Full mark, thin watery oil
diagnosticSteps: 1. Smell dipstick for gas/diesel and check viscosity. 2. Fix leaking GDI HPFP/injector or DPF regen issue immediately before bearing failure!

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Piston Ring Gap Aligned / Broken Ring — Oil Smoke Under Load
phContext: Freshly rebuilt engine smoking immediately after break-in
symptoms: Continuous blue smoke under acceleration
diagnosticSteps: 1. Perform wet compression test & leak-down test. 2. Inspect cylinder bore finish/ring end-gap.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Cylinder Head Crack Between Valve Seats — Post-Overheat
phContext: Cast-iron or aluminum diesel heads (4D56, 1KZ, 2L) overheated repeatedly
symptoms: Bubbles in radiator even with brand new head gasket!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Magnaflux / pressure-test cylinder head hot at machine shop before reassembling! 2. Replace cracked head.

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Oil Gallery Plug Left Out After Machine Shop Wash!
phContext: Freshly rebuilt engines with 0 oil pressure at first crank
symptoms: Zero oil pressure on mechanical gauge, rattling lifters
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if machine shop removed brass/screw-in oil gallery plugs behind flywheel/timing cover for hot-tanking and forgot to reinstall!

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Hydro-Locked Bent Connecting Rod — Subtle Knock & Low Comp
phContext: Flood-survivor car 'dried out' and driven without checking rod height!
symptoms: Slight vibration, 1 cylinder compression 200 kPa lower than others
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure piston TDC height through spark/glow plug hole with dial indicator/rod across all 4 cylinders! (Bent rod sits 2–5 mm lower at TDC!).

domainName: Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head, Compression & Valvetrain Diagnostics
title: Timing Cover Oil Seal Lip Rolled — Instant Leak After Belt Job
phContext: Cars leaking oil from crank/cam seal 1 day after timing service
symptoms: Steady oil drip from bottom of timing cover
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull crank sprocket and inspect front oil seal (lip rolled inward or dry-installed onto grooved crank sleeve). 2. Install seal with plastic sleeve tool.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo Compressor Wheel Eroded by Dust — Torn Airbox Hose
phContext: Pickups/vans running dusty provincial roads with unclipped airbox
symptoms: Loud turbo whistle, sluggish boost, P0299
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove turbo intake hose and inspect compressor blades for rounded/chipped leading edges ('sandblasted'!). 2. Fix air filter leak and replace turbo cartridge.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbocharger Oil Drain Pipe Kinked/Clogged — Blue Smoke at Idle
phContext: Engines after turbo replacement using liquid silicone gasket on drain!
symptoms: Thick blue oil smoke out tailpipe ONLY at hot idle!
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER use RTV silicone on turbo oil drain flange (squeezed RTV blocks drain!). 2. Check oil drain hose for kinks/sludge backing oil past turbine seal!

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo Oil Feed Banjo Bolt Mesh Screen Clogged — Starved Turbo
phContext: Ford, Hyundai, Subaru, Peugeot/Chinese turbo engines
symptoms: Brand new replacement turbo seizes within 500 km!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect hollow oil-feed banjo bolt at block/turbo for tiny internal wire-mesh screen clogged with carbon! 2. Clean/remove screen per OEM TSB and replace feed pipe.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Wastegate Actuator Vacuum/Pressure Hose Popped Off — Overboost
phContext: Turbo-gasoline/diesel cars; oil-swollen hose blew off nipple
symptoms: Sudden massive pull followed by fuel-cut limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect rubber hose between compressor housing, boost solenoid, and wastegate can! 2. Replace with silicone hose & spring clamps.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Intercooler Fin Mud-Pack — High Intake Air Temp (IAT2 >75°C)
phContext: Off-road pickups & vans; dried mud cementing intercooler fins
symptoms: Car feels sluggish after 15 min driving in hot weather
diagnosticSteps: 1. Shine flashlight behind front bumper/fender intercooler (blocked light = mud cake!). 2. Gently wash fins from back to front with low-pressure water.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Compressor Surge ('Flutter / Choo-Choo') on Throttle Lift
phContext: Turbo-gasoline crossovers; torn diverter valve or unplugged vacuum line
symptoms: Fluttering noise on shifts, turbo shaft bearing stress
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect vacuum hose / electrical plug on compressor bypass/blow-off valve. 2. Test diaphragm vacuum hold with hand pump.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo Boost Control Solenoid Circuit Low — Shorted Coil/Wire
phContext: Diesel/gasoline turbo cars; heat-melted solenoid wire near turbo
symptoms: Zero boost, MIL on, blown actuator fuse
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure boost solenoid coil resistance (15–35 ohms). 2. Inspect wire routing away from hot exhaust turbine housing.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo Exhaust Manifold Gasket Blowing — High-Pitch Squeal Under Boost
phContext: Pickups/vans (Hilux, Ranger, Montero); warped exhaust manifold
symptoms: Loud kazoo/trumpet screech ONLY when turbo spools >10 psi!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Look for black carbon soot streaks around exhaust manifold ports and turbo inlet flange! 2. Skim warped manifold flat and install new multi-layer steel (MLS) gasket.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: VGT Turbo Actuator Linkage Seized at Pivot Pin — Rust/Soot
phContext: Pickups sitting unused for months during pandemic/typhoons
symptoms: No boost or overboost limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unclip C-clip on VGT actuator rod and move turbo vane arm by hand (external pivot bushing often rusts!). 2. Free with high-temp anti-seize or clean internal vanes.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Intercooler Resonator / Silencer Box Cracked — Boost Leak
phContext: Ford, Mitsubishi, Isuzu plastic intake resonators
symptoms: Hissing under acceleration, black smoke
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pressurize charge air system with smoke/air at 100 kPa and inspect plastic resonator chamber seams! 2. Replace cracked resonator.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Dual-Stage Bi-Turbo Changeover Valve Stuck (Ford 2.0 / Mazda 2.2)
phContext: 2019+ Ford Ranger/Everest 2.0 Bi-Turbo; stuck turbine bypass flap
symptoms: Dead below 2500 RPM, sudden surge at 3000 RPM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect vacuum lines and position sensor on turbo changeover actuator. 2. Check for carbon seizure on flap shaft.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo Shaft Radial/Axial Play Excessive — Blades Scraping Housing
phContext: High-mileage turbos (>180,000 km) with neglected oil changes
symptoms: Loud siren/dentist-drill whine, metallic glitter in intercooler
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check shaft axial in-and-out play (MUST be zero!) and radial play (blades must never touch housing!). 2. Rebuild/replace turbo & flush intercooler.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Aftermarket 'Open' Blow-Off Valve Causing Rich Stall on MAF Cars!
phContext: Modified turbo-gasoline cars venting metered air to atmosphere
symptoms: Engine stalls every time clutch is pressed after boost!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Cars with MAF sensors MUST recirculate bypassed air back into intake pipe (venting to atmosphere dumps metered air, causing massive rich stall!). 2. Reinstall recirculating bypass valve.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo Boost Sensor A Circuit Low — Pinched Wire at Bracket
phContext: Pickups after intercooler/timing service
symptoms: Zero boost reading (0 kPa), limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 5V VREF, GND, and signal at MAP/Boost sensor plug. 2. Repair pinched wire.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo Coolant Line Banjo Weeping — Boiled Dry After Shutdown
phContext: Water-cooled turbo-gasoline cars (EcoBoost, Honda 1.5T, Geely)
symptoms: Sweet coolant smell near turbo after parking, low reservoir
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pressure-test cooling system cold and inspect braided/steel coolant feed & return lines on turbo center cartridge! 2. Replace copper washers or O-rings.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Collapsed Turbo Inlet Hose (Intake Pipe) Under High Boost
phContext: Older turbo diesels with oil-softened rubber intake hose before turbo
symptoms: Engine pulls strong to 2500 RPM then chokes/stalls at 3500 RPM!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Have helper rev engine while watching rubber hose between airbox and turbo compressor inlet (soft hose sucks flat under turbo suction!). 2. Replace with reinforced hose.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo Boost Control Solenoid High — Short to 12V
phContext: Wiring rubbed on alternator/AC bracket
symptoms: Overboost limp mode, P0048
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test solenoid control wire for short to 12V. 2. Replace shorted solenoid.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo Actuator Vacuum Pump Weak (Diesel) — Poor Brakes + No Boost
phContext: Alternator-mounted or cam-driven vacuum pump failing
symptoms: Hard brake pedal AND sluggish turbo spool together!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Attach vacuum gauge to main vacuum manifold: must pull -75 to -90 kPa (-22 to -26 inHg) within 3 seconds! 2. Fix vacuum leak or replace vacuum pump.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Oil Pooling in Intercooler Lower Tank — Excessive Crankcase Pressure
phContext: High-mileage diesels; oil mist condensing in intercooler bottom
symptoms: Puddles of oil dripping from intercooler hose clamp
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drain pooled oil from intercooler bottom! 2. Check PCV separator & turbo compressor seal. 3. Never let oil pool >100 mL (runaway hazard!).

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Boost Sensor Stuck High — Carbon-Plugged Intake Port
phContext: Diesels with EGR soot sealing MAP sensor cavity
symptoms: Limp mode, MAP reads 250 kPa at idle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove MAP/Boost sensor and clean soot plug in intake manifold boss. 2. Test sensor sweep with hand pressure pump.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo Exhaust Housing Cracked Around Wastegate Port
phContext: High-mileage turbo-gasoline cars; thermal cracks at internal flap
symptoms: Slow spool, rattling wastegate, P0299
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove downpipe/O2 sensor and borescope internal wastegate flapper seat for radial cracks. 2. Replace exhaust housing/turbo.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo Cartridge Rotated / Misaligned During Rebuild — Oil Leaks
phContext: Rebuilt turbos where CHRA oil drain isn't pointing straight down!
symptoms: Smokes heavily after rebuild
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify turbo CHRA oil drain port sits within +/- 15° of vertical straight down! (Tilted drain traps oil in cartridge!). 2. Re-clock CHRA.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Exceeded Learning Limit
phContext: Ford Ranger/Everest, Toyota 2GD, Mitsubishi; VGT stop screw tampered
symptoms: Wrench/MIL on, P003A
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER turn factory painted VGT mechanical stop screw! 2. Clean vanes and run scan-tool VGT Actuator Learn routine.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Supercharger / Turbo Bypass Solenoid Vacuum Tank Cracked
phContext: Vehicles with plastic vacuum reservoir ball under intake/fender
symptoms: Erratic boost at light throttle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Hand-vacuum-test plastic vacuum reservoir and one-way check valve. 2. Replace cracked reservoir.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Silicon / Gasket Debris Inside Intercooler — Post-Overhaul Risk
phContext: Engines rebuilt without flushing intercooler after blown turbo!
symptoms: New engine ingests metal blade fragments from old blown turbo!
diagnosticSteps: 1. CRITICAL RULE: After ANY turbo wheel failure, ALWAYS remove and flush (or replace!) the intercooler & charge pipes before starting the engine!

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Boost Pressure Sensor A Circuit — Unplugged After Airbox Service
phContext: All turbo diesels/gasoline cars
symptoms: Immediate limp mode, no boost
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect T-MAP / Boost sensor plug on intercooler cold-side pipe or intake manifold. 2. Reseat connector.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Intercooler Hose Clamp Stripped — Pops Off Every Hard Acceleration
phContext: Cars using cheap worm-gear hose clamps on 20+ psi boost
symptoms: Sudden loud pop + stall in overtaking lane!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace weak worm-gear clamps on turbo charge pipes with heavy-duty stainless T-bolt clamps and clean oil off metal pipe beads!

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo Heat Shield Rattling Against Downpipe — Missing Bolt
phContext: 5+ year old turbo cars; rusted/snapped heat shield tab
symptoms: Loud tinny buzz at 2200 RPM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Tap turbo heat shield cold to find loose corner. 2. Re-bolt or clamp with stainless band clamp.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo VGT Position Sensor Circuit Low — Water in Actuator
phContext: Electronic VGT actuators after flood crossing
symptoms: Limp mode, VGT position reads 0%
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug VGT actuator and check for floodwater/green pins. 2. Check 5V VREF and GND at actuator plug. 3. Replace actuator.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Electric Supercharger / e-Booster Fault (48V Mild Hybrid)
phContext: Modern 48V mild-hybrid SUVs
symptoms: Sluggish low-end launch, 48V warning
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan 48V e-Booster module and check 48V bus voltage & cooling loop.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Boost Leak at EGR Cooler Gasket — Soot & Whistle
phContext: Diesel pickups; blown metal gasket between exhaust manifold & EGR
symptoms: Black soot around EGR flange, sluggish spool
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect EGR pipe flanges for black soot plumes! 2. Replace metal gaskets & torque bolts.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo Wastegate Solenoid A — Open Coil
phContext: Turbo-gasoline cars; broken wire at turbo solenoid
symptoms: Underboost, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure solenoid coil (20–35 ohms) and check 12V IG1 feed. 2. Repair pigtail.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo Oil Seal Leak From Clogged DPF Backpressure!
phContext: Euro-4+ diesels with severely plugged DPF
symptoms: Oil pushing out of turbo seals into exhaust/intake!
diagnosticSteps: 1. High exhaust backpressure (>40 kPa) forces oil back through turbo piston-ring seals! 2. Clean/fix clogged DPF BEFORE condemning turbocharger!

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Charge Pipe O-Ring Missing (Quick-Connect Bayonet Fitting)
phContext: Ford, BMW, Hyundai, European turbo pipes; green Viton O-ring lost
symptoms: Loud hiss under boost, oily spray around coupler
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unclip wire retaining clip on plastic bayonet boost pipe and verify thick green Viton O-ring is seated inside groove! 2. Replace flattened O-ring.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: MAF Low After Boost Pipe Blow-Off — Unmetered Air Bypass
phContext: Turbo cars where charge pipe blew off completely
symptoms: Engine stalls immediately on startup, P0102 + P0299
diagnosticSteps: 1. Reconnect popped intercooler hose (unmetered air bypasses MAF or vents to zero!). 2. Clear codes.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo Compressor Nut Loosened — Wheel Spinout Risk
phContext: Cheap aftermarket/rebuilt turbo cartridges
symptoms: Sudden rattle then silence + smoke
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect compressor wheel nut & shaft balance. 2. Replace with balanced OEM CHRA.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Vacuum Reservoir One-Way Check Valve Installed Backwards!
phContext: DIYer reassembling vacuum hoses after valve cover job
symptoms: Turbo vanes never move, zero boost
diagnosticSteps: 1. Blow through inline plastic check valve: flow MUST allow vacuum FROM manifold/pump TO reservoir, never backwards!

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbo Boost Control Position Sensor A Stuck Low — Ford/GM
phContext: Ford Ranger/EcoBoost; sticking electronic actuator
symptoms: Wrench light, P2598
diagnosticSteps: 1. Command actuator sweep via scan tool while watching position PID. 2. Clean vanes or replace actuator.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbocharger Pre-Oiling Skipped After Replacement — Instant Scoring!
phContext: Freshly installed turbo started dry without priming oil feed
symptoms: New turbo whines on first startup!
diagnosticSteps: 1. ALWAYS fill turbo oil feed port with clean engine oil and crank with injectors unplugged for 10 sec until oil pressure builds BEFORE starting new turbo!

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Intake Air Temp (IAT2) Heat Soak in Traffic — Timing Pull
phContext: Top-mount intercooler diesels/SUVs (Montero/Fortuner/Hilux) in 40°C crawl
symptoms: Noticeably sluggish acceleration after 20 min idling in traffic
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check intercooler fan (if equipped) and hood scoop seal rubber! 2. Clean intercooler fins.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Turbocharger Overspeed — Altitude / Boost Leak Combo
phContext: Turbo vehicles climbing Baguio with small boost leak (turbo spins faster to compensate!)
symptoms: P0049 stored, high-pitch turbo scream at altitude
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pressure-test charge pipes for boost leak! (A small leak at high altitude forces turbo past max RPM limit). 2. Fix leak.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Wastegate Diaphragm Ruptured — Holds Zero Vacuum/Pressure
phContext: Older turbo cars; heat-rotted rubber diaphragm inside actuator can
symptoms: Overboost fuel cut or zero boost
diagnosticSteps: 1. Connect hand pressure/vacuum pump directly to wastegate actuator nipple: must hold pressure & move rod smoothly! 2. Replace actuator.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Particulate Filter / Catalyst Missing — Straight-Pipe Exhaust
phContext: Modified diesel pickups with cat/DPF removed
symptoms: MIL on, P226D/P2002
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect exhaust underbody for missing DPF/cat. 2. Restore OEM emission hardware.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Oil Return Hose Swollen Shut Internally — Wrong Fuel/Oil Hose
phContext: Shop used standard non-oil-rated coolant hose for turbo drain!
symptoms: Blue smoke after 1 week, hose mushy inside
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace with genuine high-temp Viton/silicone turbo oil drain hose.

domainName: Turbocharger, Supercharger, Intercooler & Boost Plumbing Faults
title: Billet / Oversized Aftermarket Turbo Causing Surge at Low RPM
phContext: Modified pickups with large turbo on stock fuel/tuning
symptoms: Chuffing surge noise at 1800 RPM uphill
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check VGT vane calibration or anti-surge housing / boost control map.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: LPG Vaporizer / Reducer Freezing Solid — Low Coolant Flow
phContext: LPG-converted taxis/Vios/Avanza; air pocket or pinched heater tee
symptoms: Engine stalls on LPG switchover, thick white frost on aluminum vaporizer!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Feel LPG vaporizer body (must be hot 80°C like engine coolant!). 2. Bleed air from coolant heater hoses feeding vaporizer and check radiator level! 3. Check T-fittings.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: LPG Bi-Fuel Lean Trim — Worn LPG Injector Calibration / Filter
phContext: Sequential LPG systems >40,000 km; clogged vapor-phase LPG filter
symptoms: Engine runs fine on gasoline, shakes/misfires & sets P0171 on LPG!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Switch car to Gasoline for 10 min: if misfire/lean clears completely, fault is strictly in LPG system! 2. Replace liquid & vapor LPG filters and check LPG rail pressure.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Hard Cold Start Morning (LPG Bi-Fuel) — Leaking LPG Injector/Reducer
phContext: LPG cars flooding intake manifold with propane overnight!
symptoms: Cranks 8 sec every morning on gasoline, then fires with exhaust pop!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull LPG vacuum reference hose off vaporizer overnight or soapy-water test LPG injector tips key-off! 2. Leaking diaphragm/injector fills intake with gas overnight. 3. Rebuild vaporizer/injectors.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Gasoline Injector Emulator Open — Faulty LPG Cut-Off Box
phContext: LPG cars; broken solder joint inside LPG injector emulator harness
symptoms: Cylinder #1 dead even when switched back to Gasoline!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug LPG inline injector emulator harness and plug factory injector connectors straight onto injectors! 2. If cylinder wakes up, repair LPG emulator harness.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: E10 Gasoline Phase Separation — Water & Ethanol Layer in Tank
phContext: Cars parked 2+ months during rainy season with 1/4 tank E10
symptoms: Engine sputters, white exhaust steam, refuses to rev
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pump fuel sample into clear glass jar: cloudy milky bottom layer = water-ethanol phase separation! 2. Drain tank completely, flush lines, and refill fresh RON 95.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Fuel Injector Pintle Gummed by Stale Gasoline — Parked Vehicle
phContext: Project cars / OFW cars parked 6+ months
symptoms: Cranks with spark & fuel pressure, zero fuel entering cylinders!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check noid light at injector plugs (pulses good!). 2. Remove fuel rail and test injectors on ultrasonic bench: varnished fuel glues pintles shut! 3. Ultrasonic clean & backflush.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Fuel Rail Pressure Sensor Low — Shorted Signal Wire
phContext: GDI/CRDi vehicles; wire chaffed on intake bracket
symptoms: No-start or limp mode, FRP reads 0 MPa
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug FRP sensor: if PID jumps to 5V/max, sensor is shorted to ground! 2. Inspect 3-wire harness to ECM.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: LPG Solenoid Valve Won't Open — Burned 12V Coil at Tank/Engine
phContext: LPG vehicles; clicks? No — runs on gas only, beeps 'Empty'
symptoms: Switches right back to gasoline with error beep
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure 12V at tank multivalve solenoid & engine lockoff solenoid when LPG switches ON. 2. Measure coil resistance (10–20 ohms). 3. Replace burned coil.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Fuel Pump Relay / Fuse Good, Pump Dead — Grounded Through Sender
phContext: Cars with rusted fuel pump ground pin at tank top connector
symptoms: Pump stops intermittently over bumps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect 4/5-pin connector on top of fuel tank hat for melted ground pin (high current!). 2. Re-pin connector & clean tank ground.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Returnless Fuel System Pressure Drop — Cracked In-Tank Regulator
phContext: Modern EFI cars (regulator inside tank!); cracked plastic housing
symptoms: Long cranking, low rail pressure (<200 kPa), drops instantly key-off
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull fuel pump module and inspect internal plastic fuel pressure regulator O-rings and housing for hairline splits! 2. Replace regulator/housing.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Wrong Octane Fuel (RON 91 in High-Compression GDI) — Knock/Ping
phContext: Modern turbo/high-comp cars running cheapest RON 91 in hot traffic
symptoms: Rattling marble sound accelerating uphill with A/C on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check owner's manual minimum RON (many turbos/GDIs require RON 95+!). 2. Refill RON 95/97 and check knock sensor retard PIDs.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Cylinder 1 Injector Circuit Low — Pinched Wire Under Rail
phContext: EFI/GDI cars after intake/valve cover service
symptoms: Dead cylinder #1, P0261
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug injector #1 and check harness wires for short to ground (metal fuel rail bracket pinches wire!). 2. Repair wire.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Diesel Fuel Tank Vacuum Lock — Clogged Tank Breather
phContext: Pickups/vans stalling after 30 min continuous highway driving
symptoms: Engine starves and dies, loud 'WHOOSH' when fuel cap opened!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Open diesel cap immediately when truck dies: heavy air suction = plugged tank vent! 2. Clear vent valve/hose on tank.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: LPG Map/Pressure Sensor Fault — Oil Sludge in Vapor Line
phContext: Sequential LPG systems; heavy-ends oil from dirty LPG clogging sensor
symptoms: Switches off LPG under acceleration
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove 4-pin LPG pressure/temp sensor on injector rail and clean oily wax gently. 2. Replace vapor filter.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Bank 2 Lean — Pinched Fuel Crossover Hose (V6)
phContext: V6 engines; kinked flexible line feeding Bank 2 rail
symptoms: Bank 2 misfires under load while Bank 1 is fine
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect fuel crossover hose between left & right rails. 2. Check Bank 2 injectors & intake gaskets.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Fuel Rail Pulsation Damper Leaking Gas — Fire Hazard!
phContext: Older Toyota/Mitsubishi/Nissan EFI rails; weeping diaphragm
symptoms: Strong gas smell under hood, wet fuel dripping onto hot manifold
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect round canister fuel pulsation damper screwed into fuel rail end for wet fuel! 2. Replace damper & O-ring immediately!

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Injector 4 Circuit Open — Corroded Connector Lock Tab
phContext: High-vibration diesels/gasoline cars; broken plastic clip
symptoms: Intermittent cylinder #4 misfire over bumps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Wiggle injector #4 plug at idle while listening for miss. 2. Replace broken connector housing (never zip-tie loose plug permanently).

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Gasoline Contaminated With Diesel (Misfueled at Station!)
phContext: Gasoline car accidentally filled with diesel at gas station
symptoms: Thick white smoke, knocks loudly, stalls 200 meters from station
diagnosticSteps: 1. DO NOT keep cranking! Drain fuel tank, flush lines, purge fuel rail, and clean/replace spark plugs! 2. Change oil if diluted.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Diesel Contaminated With Gasoline (Misfueled at Station!)
phContext: CRDi diesel pickup accidentally filled with gasoline!
symptoms: Loud diesel clatter, stalls, severe HP pump/injector seizure risk!
diagnosticSteps: 1. DO NOT start engine if caught at pump! Tow to shop, drain tank completely, flush low-pressure lines, replace fuel filter, prime with clean diesel! 2. Inspect HP pump for metal shavings.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: GDI Fuel Rail Pressure Sensor Skew — Heat-Soak Drift
phContext: GDI crossovers stalling after 10-min hot park (grocery stop)
symptoms: Cranks long after quick stop, P0191
diagnosticSteps: 1. Monitor rail pressure PID during hot soak (verify pressure builds >4 MPa cleanly). 2. Check low-side lift pump check valve.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: LPG Gauge Always Reads Full or Empty — Tank Float Sensor
phContext: LPG-converted cars; misaligned Hall sender on toroidal/cylindrical tank
symptoms: LPG LED bar inaccurate
diagnosticSteps: 1. Rotate small 2/3-wire Hall sensor dial on tank multivalve slightly while watching dash LEDs, or replace sensor.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Diesel Injection Pump Metering Control Range — Water/Rust
phContext: Ford/Nissan/Hyundai CRDi; rusted IMV/SCV spool
symptoms: Surging idle, stalling, P0252
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove IMV/SCV and inspect for rust/pitting from water in diesel. 2. Drain tank water and replace IMV + filter.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: In-Tank Fuel Pump Hose Split — Pump Runs, 0 PSI at Engine!
phContext: Cars with replacement generic pump motor installed with non-submersible hose!
symptoms: Pump hums loudly, 0 kPa at rail (fuel sprays inside tank!)
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull pump assembly: standard exterior fuel hose turns to jelly when submerged in E10 gas! 2. Use SAE 30R10 submersible-rated fuel hose + Oetiker clamps!

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Rich Trim After Installing Larger/Wrong Aftermarket Injectors
phContext: Used car bought with mismatched pink/blue surplus injectors
symptoms: Black smoke, fouled plugs, LTFT -25%
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check OEM part number stamped on all 4 injectors! (Wrong cc/min flow rate floods engine). 2. Install exact OEM flow-matched injectors.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Fuel Line Vibration Rattle Against Firewall — Missing Plastic Clips
phContext: Cars after engine/clutch job; fuel pipes tapping floorpan
symptoms: Annoying metallic buzz under driver feet at 1500 RPM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Snap underbody steel fuel/brake lines back into plastic frame clips! 2. Add foam sleeve if near heat shield.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Theft Detected — Fuel Pump Disabled by Immobilizer (Ford/Mazda)
phContext: Ford/Mazda PATS active; cranks or won't crank, zero fuel
symptoms: Rapid red padlock flash, P1260
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check PATS key recognition & cluster solder joints. 2. Re-sync/program keys.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Diesel Return Line Blocked — Blows Injector Return Seals!
phContext: Pickups/vans; crushed steel return pipe under chassis from rock/jack
symptoms: High rail pressure at idle, diesel spraying from valve cover return!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect return line at engine and blow low-pressure air back to tank (must flow freely!). 2. Straighten/replace pinched return pipe.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Cylinder 2 Injector Circuit Low — Shorted Piezo/Solenoid
phContext: Diesels/GDI; internal coil short to ground
symptoms: Engine shuts down bank/all injectors, P0264
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug injector #2 and ohm-test pins to each other and to injector body (>10 MΩ). 2. Replace shorted injector.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Car Runs Out of Gas at 1/4 Tank — Bent Float Arm / Jet Pump
phContext: Vehicles after fuel pump replacement; float arm bent hitting tank wall
symptoms: Gauge still shows 1/4 tank when car sputters empty!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull pump module and verify float arm swings freely without hitting tank baffle or hoses! 2. Check saddle-tank transfer siphon if AWD.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Fuel Pressure Regulator 1 Control Low — Shorted SCV Wire
phContext: Toyota/Mitsubishi/Isuzu CRDi; chafed SCV harness
symptoms: Limp mode or max rail pressure knock
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug SCV and inspect 2-pin pigtail for short to ground. 2. Check ECM SCV driver.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: External Inline Fuel Filter Installed Backwards — Flow Arrow!
phContext: Older EFI cars/vans with directional metal inline filter
symptoms: Starves above 3000 RPM, filter collapses internally
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 'FLOW ->' arrow stamped on metal filter canister (must point toward engine!). 2. Replace filter in correct direction.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Fuel Temp Sensor Low — Shorted to Ground in Tank/Rail
phContext: Diesels/flex-fuel cars; fuel temp reads +140°C
symptoms: MIL on, skewed fuel trim
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug fuel temp sensor; if PID flips to -40°C, replace sensor.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: GDI Injector Teflon Combustion Seal Missing — Blow-By
phContext: GDI engines after injector removal without special Teflon seal sizer!
symptoms: Misfire, loud ticking, fuel smell in engine bay
diagnosticSteps: 1. Whenever pulling GDI injectors, ALWAYS replace white Teflon tip seals and compress them with OEM sizing cone before install!

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Injection Timing Control Circuit — Older Diesel Electronic VE Pump
phContext: Older Isuzu/Toyota/Mitsubishi semi-electronic rotary pumps (2LTE/4M40)
symptoms: Loud diesel knock, white smoke, limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure Timing Control Valve (TCV) coil resistance (10–14 ohms) at pump bottom. 2. Clean clogged inlet strainer screen under pump.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Fuel Tank Rust Pinholes Under Foam Pad — Slow Drip
phContext: Older SUVs/vans with tank straps lined with wet foam trapping mud
symptoms: Gasoline drip only when tank filled >3/4
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect top/side seams of metal fuel tank under mounting straps! 2. Replace rusted tank.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Fuel Level Sensor Circuit — Stuck Float / Slosh Damping
phContext: Cars parked on steep incline triggering false fuel code
symptoms: MIL on after parking on steep hill, clears
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify fuel gauge moves smoothly from E to F. 2. Inspect tank sender if stuck.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Injector Cleaner Additive Dislodged Tank Sludge — Clogged Filters
phContext: High-mileage car given strong fuel additive for first time in 100k km
symptoms: Runs worse 1 day after pouring fuel-system cleaner in tank!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Dissolved tank varnish washed into fuel filter sock & injector micro-baskets! 2. Replace fuel filter sock & clean injector micro-filters.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Cylinder 5 Injector Circuit — V6 Rear Bank Rodent Bite
phContext: V6 SUVs/vans parked outdoors
symptoms: Dead cylinder #5, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect V6 valley harness under intake plenum for rat chew marks. 2. Repair injector wire.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: LPG Conversion Backfire Blowing Airbox Open (Mixer Type)
phContext: Older 1st/2nd-gen Venturi LPG cars with weak spark plugs
symptoms: Loud bang under hood, cracked plastic air filter box
diagnosticSteps: 1. Venturi/mixer LPG requires tight spark plug gap (0.7–0.8 mm) and healthy ignition wires! 2. Fix ignition misfire & replace airbox.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Low Pressure Fuel System Too Low — Weak Lift Pump
phContext: Modern GDI/CRDi with monitored low-side pressure sensor
symptoms: Hard start, P008A + P0087
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure low-side pressure mechanically (400–550 kPa). 2. Replace clogged in-tank filter or weak lift pump.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Fuel Quick-Connect Clip Broken — Line Pops Off Under Pressure!
phContext: Cars after filter/engine work; brittle plastic retaining clip
symptoms: Engine dies instantly, gasoline spraying across engine bay!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always tug firmly on quick-connect fuel fittings after clicking them on! 2. Replace broken nylon retaining clip immediately.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Cylinder 3 Injector Circuit Low — Internal Short
phContext: CRDi/GDI; shorted coil
symptoms: Misfire/shutoff, P0267
diagnosticSteps: 1. Ohm-test injector #3 coil & insulation to ground. 2. Replace shorted injector.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Diesel Fuel Heater / Primer Air Bleeder Screw Stripped
phContext: Pickups/vans; rounded plastic air-bleed screw on filter head
symptoms: Air leaks in, hard morning start
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace stripped plastic bleed screw with brass/OEM bleeder + fresh O-ring.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Fuel Pressure Regulator 1 Exceeded Control Limits — Too Low
phContext: GDI/CRDi; HPFP worn or fuel starvation
symptoms: Limp mode under load
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify low-side supply volume & pressure first. 2. Test HPFP & spill valve.

domainName: Fuel Injection, Bi-Fuel LPG/CNG & Fuel Contamination Faults
title: Dirty Micro-Basket Filters Inside EFI Injectors
phContext: High-mileage Vios/City/Mirage; fine rust passing main filter
symptoms: Lean misfire at high RPM despite 350 kPa rail pressure
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull injectors, extract tiny brass/nylon micro-basket filters from injector tops using drywall screw, and install new basket filters!

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Clutch Pedal Spongy / Grabs Right Off Floor — Air in Hydraulics
phContext: Manual Hilux, Ranger, Vios, Mirage; worn master/slave seals
symptoms: Hard to shift into 1st/Reverse, grinds Reverse
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check clutch fluid reservoir (dark/low = worn master/slave cylinder). 2. Reverse-bleed or pressure-bleed clutch line. 3. Replace leaking master/slave pair together.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Clutch Slips in 4th/5th Gear Uphill — Worn Friction Disc / Oil
phContext: Manual commuters & delivery vans; engine revs without speeding up
symptoms: Burning clutch smell on inclines, high RPMs
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify pedal has 10–15 mm freeplay (tight cable/pushrod holds clutch slightly open!). 2. Check bottom of bellhousing for oil (rear main seal) vs. dry wear. 3. Replace clutch kit.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Throwout / Release Bearing Squealing — Disappears When Pedal Pressed
phContext: Manual cars where driver rests foot on clutch pedal at stoplights
symptoms: Chirping/whirring noise at idle, stops when lightly touching clutch
diagnosticSteps: 1. Teach driver not to ride clutch pedal! 2. Drop transmission and replace release bearing + inspect pressure plate fingers for wear.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Pilot Bearing Grinding ONLY When Clutch Pressed in Gear!
phContext: High-mileage manual pickups/vans; dry/seized pilot bearing in crank
symptoms: Loud screech when holding clutch down in 1st gear at stoplight
diagnosticSteps: 1. Note: Throwout bearing spins whenever pedal is pressed; pilot bearing spins ONLY when crank & input shaft turn at different speeds (pedal pressed)! 2. Replace pilot bearing.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Dual-Mass Flywheel (DMF) Seized / Excessive Rock — Harsh Chatter
phContext: Ford Ranger, Nissan Navara, Isuzu; fatigued internal arc springs
symptoms: Loud rattle at shutoff, violent shudder on takeoff
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure DMF rotational freeplay (>2–3 ring-gear teeth or >15 mm = worn) and axial rock. 2. Replace DMF with LuK/Sachs OEM unit (avoid solid-mass conversion if gearbox rattles!).

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Clutch Fork Pivot Ball Snapped / Punched Through Fork
phContext: Older manual pickups/vans; ungreased pivot ball wearing through stamped fork
symptoms: Pedal suddenly drops dead or feels super heavy, won't disengage
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect slave cylinder pushrod sticking out abnormally far! 2. Drop gearbox to replace worn clutch fork & pivot ball.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Manual Transmission Pops Out of 2nd or 5th Gear on Decel
phContext: High-mileage manual cars/trucks; worn synchronizer teeth / detent
symptoms: Gear lever kicks back to Neutral when lifting off gas
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check worn/torn engine & transmission mounts FIRST (excessive engine rock yanks shifter cable!). 2. Check shifter cable bushings. 3. Overhaul worn 2nd/5th gear synchronizer sleeve.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Grinding Into 2nd or 3rd Gear Only — Worn Brass Synchro Ring
phContext: Manual cars shifted aggressively or using GL-5 gear oil in GL-4 box!
symptoms: Crunches shifting quickly into 2nd/3rd, smooth if double-clutched
diagnosticSteps: 1. CRITICAL: Check gear oil spec! GL-5 sulfur additives corrode yellow brass synchro rings in GL-4 manual gearboxes! 2. Drain and refill proper GL-4 oil; overhaul worn synchros.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Limited-Slip Differential (LSD) Chatter on Tight Turns
phContext: 4x4 pickups/SUVs (Hilux, Montero, Navara, Ranger) with clutch-type LSD
symptoms: Groaning/shudderin g from rear axle during U-turns
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check rear diff oil: clutch-type LSDs REQUIRE GL-5 LSD Friction-Modifier oil! (Standard oil causes chatter!). 2. Drain & refill genuine LSD gear oil.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Rear Differential Pinion Bearing Roar — Coast vs. Drive
phContext: High-mileage pickups/vans/jeepneys; low oil or floodwater
symptoms: Howling noise above 50 km/h
diagnosticSteps: 1. Noise on throttle only = ring/pinion tooth wear; noise on coast/decel = front pinion bearing preload lost; noise all the time = carrier/wheel bearings! 2. Rebuild diff.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Driveshaft U-Joint Seized — Squeaks at Low Speed & Vibrates
phContext: RWD pickups/vans/trucks; dry needle bearings with red rust dust
symptoms: Squeaking chirp in Reverse, vibration at 60 km/h
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect U-joint bearing caps for red iron-oxide dust! 2. Drop driveshaft and flex joints by hand (must pivot smoothly with zero binding!). 3. Replace U-joints.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Manual Transmission Input Shaft Bearing Roar in Neutral
phContext: Manual cars >120,000 km; noisy in Neutral, quiet when clutch pressed!
symptoms: Whirring/grinding sound idling in Neutral that stops when pedal pressed
diagnosticSteps: 1. Noise in Neutral pedal-UP that vanishes pedal-DOWN = transmission input shaft bearing! 2. Check gear oil level; overhaul transmission bearings.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Clutch Hydraulic Hose Ballooning Hot — Soft Pedal in Traffic
phContext: Older manual trucks/cars; internally frayed rubber flex hose
symptoms: Pedal works cold, fails to disengage after 30 min in traffic
diagnosticSteps: 1. Have helper press clutch while watching rubber flex hose near slave cylinder (swells like balloon = failed hose!). 2. Replace with braided stainless/new OEM hose.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Flywheel Hot-Spots / Heat-Cracks — Judder on Takeoff
phContext: Vehicles driven with slipping clutch until rivets scored flywheel
symptoms: Car shakes violently releasing clutch in 1st & Reverse
diagnosticSteps: 1. Never bolt a new clutch onto a blued, heat-checked flywheel! 2. Machine/resurface flywheel flat (and verify step-height spec!) or replace.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: 4x4 Front Axle CV Boot Torn — Grease Slung Onto Brake Rotor
phContext: Lifted 4x4 pickups (severe CV angle pinching inner/outer boots)
symptoms: Clicking on turns, grease smoke from hot front brake
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect inner & outer CV boots on front half-shafts (lifted trucks need diff-drop or high-angle silicone boots!). 2. Repack CV joint & install new boot.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Manual Shifter Stiff Left-to-Right — Seized Selector Cable
phContext: FWD manual cars (Vios, Mirage, Ertiga); rusted cable near exhaust
symptoms: Shifter won't spring back to center Neutral gate
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect BOTH shifter cables at transmission top levers: if lever on gearbox moves freely by hand, cable is seized! 2. Replace shifter cable pair.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Differential Pinion Oil Seal Leak — Plugged Vent / Grooved Yoke
phContext: RWD pickups/SUVs; oil slinging onto underbody
symptoms: Gear oil wet around front of rear differential
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean plugged axle breather FIRST! 2. Inspect pinion flange sealing surface for wear groove (use Speedi-Sleeve if grooved). 3. Replace seal & mark pinion nut position precisely!

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: 4x4 Transfer Case Input Seal Leak — Transmission Fluid Overfilling T-Case
phContext: 4x4 pickups/SUVs; failed seal between gearbox and transfer case
symptoms: Transfer case overfilled & blowing oil out vent while gearbox runs low!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check BOTH transmission and transfer case fluid levels! 2. Replace double-lip seal between transmission tailhousing and transfer case.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Clutch Pedal Firewall Bracket Cracked — Flexing Sheetmetal
phContext: Older manual pickups/cars with heavy aftermarket pressure plate
symptoms: Clicking/popping at firewall when pressing clutch, poor disengagement
diagnosticSteps: 1. Watch firewall behind clutch master cylinder while pressing pedal: flexing sheetmetal = cracked spot welds! 2. Weld reinforcement plate.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: CV Axle Popped Out of Transmission — Missing Snap Ring!
phContext: Cars after suspension/ball-joint work where axle pulled too far
symptoms: Sudden loss of drive, grinding sound, ATF pouring out!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect inner CV axle circlip (must snap firmly into differential side gear!). 2. Replace stretched C-clip and seat axle completely with rubber mallet.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Manual Gear Oil Milky From Floodwater — Shifter Boot Tear
phContext: Manual pickups/vans after deep flood crossing
symptoms: Hard shifting, roaring bearings weeks after flood
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drain transmission gear oil (milky = water entered via torn shifter rubber boot or breather!). 2. Flush twice with fresh GL-4/GL-5 oil.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Broken Clutch Pressure Plate Diaphragm Finger — Sudden Hard/Dead Pedal
phContext: High-mileage manual cars
symptoms: Pedal vibrates wildly or drops dead, won't shift
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull inspection boot or transmission to inspect broken diaphragm spring fingers. 2. Replace complete clutch kit.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Driveshaft Balance Weight Knocked Off — Highway Buzz at 90+ km/h
phContext: 4x4s/vans hitting rocks/debris under chassis
symptoms: High-frequency seat/mirror vibration above 85 km/h
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect driveshaft tube for clean rectangular rust-free spot where spot-welded balance weight sheared off! 2. Re-balance driveshaft.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Reverse Gear Only Grinds When Shifting — Idler / Clutch Drag
phContext: Manual cars without synchronized Reverse gear
symptoms: Clean into 1–5, loud crunch into Reverse
diagnosticSteps: 1. Wait 3 sec with clutch down (or tap 1st gear briefly to stop input shaft!) before shifting Reverse. 2. Check clutch hydraulics if still grinds.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Axle Nut Unstaked / Backing Off — Wheel Hub Play
phContext: FWD cars after CV axle replacement where nut wasn't staked/torqued
symptoms: Clunk on braking, ruined new wheel bearing in 500 km!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Torque axle nut to exact spec (typically 200–280 N·m) and stake collar cleanly into axle shaft notch!

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Clutch Master Cylinder Pushrod Adjusted Too Tight — No Freeplay
phContext: Cars where mechanic adjusted pedal pushrod until zero freeplay
symptoms: Clutch slips ONLY after 20 min driving when fluid heats up!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Hot fluid expands and cannot bleed back into reservoir if master pushrod blocks compensating port! 2. Set 2–3 mm pushrod freeplay at clevis.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Center Differential / Viscous Coupling Binding (Full-Time AWD)
phContext: AWD crossovers/SUVs running 1 new tire + 3 worn tires
symptoms: Binding/hopping in tight parking turns, burnt coupling smell
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure tread depth/circumference of all 4 tires (AWD requires <2–3 mm variance across all 4!). 2. Match tires.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Differential Spider Gears Worn — Clunk When Turning & Accelerating
phContext: High-mileage pickups/jeepneys; one-wheel burnouts in mud
symptoms: Loud clunk from rear axle on corners
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull diff cover/carrier to inspect spider gear cross-pin & thrust washers for play/galling. 2. Replace spider gear kit.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Aftermarket 'Racing' Ceramic Puck Clutch — Unusable in EDSA Traffic
phContext: Daily-driven cars fitted with 4/6-puck unsprung ceramic clutch
symptoms: Violent chatter, stalls in traffic, snaps transmission mounts
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace aggressive puck clutch with OEM organic sprung-hub disc for smooth street drivability!

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Speedometer Gear Stripped Inside Transmission Tailhousing
phContext: Older cable/gear-driven VSS pickups & vans
symptoms: Speedometer & odometer dead while ABS/engine run fine
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unbolt 1-bolt VSS housing on transmission tail and inspect plastic driven gear teeth for stripping! 2. Replace plastic gear & O-ring.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Transmission Mount Collapsed — Shifter Moves 3 Inches on Gas
phContext: Manual & AT cars; torn rubber transmission mount
symptoms: Shifter jerks violently forward/back when pressing/releasing gas
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pry gently under transmission tailhousing to check rubber mount separation. 2. Replace transmission mount.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: 4x4 Front Hub Spline Stripped — Grinding in 4H
phContext: Older 4x4s with worn locking hub or axle stub splines
symptoms: Grinding click from front wheel in 4H
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull front hub cap and inspect axle stub splines & hub locking ring teeth. 2. Replace worn hub/shaft.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Driveshaft Slip Yoke 'Bump' When Stopping — Dry/Stuck Splines
phContext: Pickups/SUVs (Hilux, Fortuner, Montero, Ranger)
symptoms: Thud felt in seat 1 second after coming to full stop
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drop rear driveshaft, clean old hardened grease from slip-yoke internal splines, and pack with PTFE/moly slip-yoke grease!

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Clutch Slave Cylinder Piston Over-Extended — No Bellhousing Stop
phContext: Manual cars with worn clutch fork/disc
symptoms: Fluid suddenly blows out slave cylinder boot
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check clutch fork & disc wear (worn disc lets slave travel too far!). 2. Replace clutch kit & slave.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Rear Axle Shaft Bent From Curb Impact — Rear Wheel Wobble
phContext: RWD pickups/vans slid sideways into curb
symptoms: Wobbly rear tire, leaking rear axle seal, brake pulsation
diagnosticSteps: 1. Put rear on jack stands, spin wheel, and watch rim/flange runout with dial indicator! 2. Replace bent rear axle shaft.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Manual Gearbox Overfilled or Wrong Viscosity — Hard Cold Shift
phContext: Manual cars filled with thick 85W-140 diff oil instead of 75W-85/90
symptoms: Almost impossible to shift 1st–2nd in cold mornings
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drain thick oil and refill exact OEM viscosity (75W-85 / 75W-90 GL-4, or MTF per Honda/Toyota spec!).

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: CV Joint Inner Tripod Roller Fell Off During Install — Locked Axle
phContext: FWD cars after strut/ball-joint repair
symptoms: Boot twisted, axle won't turn or shakes violently
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull inner boot clamp and verify all 3 needle-bearing tripod rollers sit cleanly inside housing grooves! 2. Reassemble with CV grease.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Clutch Bleeder Valve Clogged with Mud/Rust — Can't Bleed
phContext: Pickups/vans; missing rubber bleeder cap on slave cylinder
symptoms: Zero fluid comes out when bleeding clutch
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unscrew bleeder nipple completely and clear rust plug with thin wire (or replace nipple). 2. Always reinstall rubber dust cap!

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Rear Diff Cover Gasket Weep — Plugged Breather Pressurizing Case
phContext: SUVs/trucks with bolted rear diff cover
symptoms: Diff cover weeps oil despite fresh RTV reseal
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clear plugged axle breather tube! (Thermal expansion builds 5+ psi inside axle and pushes oil past RTV!).

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: 4x4 Transfer Case Low-Range Gear Grind — Rolling While Shifting 4L
phContext: Drivers shifting 4H -> 4L while still moving 10 km/h
symptoms: Horrible gear crunch, 4L won't engage
diagnosticSteps: 1. Come to COMPLETE STOP (0 km/h), shift transmission to NEUTRAL, then engage 4L! 2. Verify shift motor works.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Starter Ring Gear Loose on Flexplate (AT) — Knocking at Idle
phContext: Automatic cars/vans; cracked stamped steel flexplate around crank bolts
symptoms: Metallic rattle/knock at idle that sounds like rod knock!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove torque converter inspection cover and inspect flexplate center hub for radial hairline cracks! (Sounds identical to rod knock!). 2. Replace flexplate.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Torque Converter Bolts Loose — Rhythmic Bellhousing Clatter
phContext: AT vehicles right after engine/transmission installation
symptoms: Knock at idle, disappears under load/high RPM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove bottom inspection plug and check torque on all 4–6 torque converter-to-flexplate bolts! 2. Apply threadlocker & torque.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: CV Axle Nut Over-Torqued — Crushed Wheel Bearing Preload
phContext: Cars where shop hammered axle nut with 1000 Nm air gun
symptoms: Brand new wheel bearing fails in 2 weeks
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always torque axle nut to exact OEM Nm spec!

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Differential Drain Plug Stripped — Cannot Service Oil
phContext: Older pickups/vans; rounded 24mm/10mm hex drain plug
symptoms: Shop skips diff oil change because plug won't budge
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always loosen FILL plug FIRST before drain plug! (So you don't drain an axle you can't refill!). 2. Weld nut onto stripped plug to remove & replace.

domainName: Manual Clutch, Flywheel, Differential & Driveshaft Mechanics
title: Clutch Return Spring Broken — Pedal Hangs Low / Triggers Cruise Off
phContext: Manual cars; broken pedal return spring
symptoms: Pedal sits 1 cm lower, cruise control won't set
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect clutch pedal upper return spring and clutch switch contact! 2. Replace spring.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Inner Edge Tire Wear Both Fronts — Excessive Toe-Out / Sagging Springs
phContext: Sedans/MPVs; worn tie-rod ends or lowered/sagging coil springs
symptoms: Front tires bald on inner shoulder while outer tread looks new
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect tie-rod ends, lower control arm bushings, and ride height. 2. Perform 4-wheel alignment setting toe strictly to spec.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Outer Edge Tire Wear Both Fronts — Excessive Toe-In / Hard Cornering
phContext: Pickups/vans; bent tie-rod or toe-in out of spec
symptoms: Outer shoulder feathered/scrubbed smooth
diagnosticSteps: 1. Run hand across tire tread: sharp saw-tooth feathering = toe error! 2. Check ball joints/bushings and align front toe.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Cupped / Scalloped Tire Wear — Blown Shock Absorbers
phContext: High-mileage SUVs/sedans; noisy tire 'thump-thump' at 50 km/h
symptoms: Alternating high/low patches around tire circumference
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace leaking/weak shock absorbers (tires bounce and slap pavement!). 2. Rotate/replace cupped tires and align.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Center-Only Tire Wear vs. Both-Edges Wear — Inflation Error
phContext: Over-inflated (45+ psi) vs. under-inflated (<24 psi) tires
symptoms: Center rib bald OR both outer shoulders bald
diagnosticSteps: 1. Calibrate tire gauge and inflate cold to door-jamb placard (typically 30–35 psi cars, 32–38 psi pickups).

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Hydraulic PS Pump Screaming & Steering Stiff — Clogged Filter/Screen
phContext: Older Honda/Toyota/Mitsubishi hydraulic PS; black burnt ATF/PSF
symptoms: Groaning noise turning wheel, heavy steering at idle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check reservoir level & fluid color. 2. Flush PS fluid using OEM PSF/Dexron per cap spec (Honda REQUIRES genuine Honda PSF — ATF ruins Honda seals!). 3. Clean reservoir screen.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Hydraulic PS Steering Heavy One Way Only — Internal Spool Valve
phContext: Older hydraulic rack-and-pinion vehicles; worn Teflon spool seals
symptoms: Easy to turn left, rock-hard to turn right!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check tire pressures & ball joints first. 2. If mechanicals are free, internal rotary spool valve Teflon rings inside steering rack pinion are worn/bypassing! 3. Rebuild/replace rack.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Bump Steer Over Potholes — Bent Strut / Unequal Tie-Rod Angle
phContext: Cars hit pothole hard; bent McPherson strut or lower arm
symptoms: Car darts sharply left/right hitting single-wheel bump
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure camber & caster on alignment rack (bent strut/knuckle throws camber off >1.5°!). 2. Replace bent strut/knuckle/arm.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
