title: Outer Tie-Rod End Play — Clunk & Loose Steering Center
phContext: All PH cars >60,000 km; torn tie-rod rubber boot
symptoms: Wheel shakes when rocked 9-and-3 o'clock, clunk on turns
diagnosticSteps: 1. Jack front wheel, grab tire at 9-and-3 o'clock, and rock while watching outer tie-rod ball stud! 2. Replace worn tie-rod ends in pairs & align.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Inner Tie-Rod (Rack End) Play — Knock Inside Steering Boot
phContext: Vios, Mirage, City, Hilux, Montero; worn inner ball-and-socket
symptoms: Clunk felt in steering wheel over rough pavement
diagnosticSteps: 1. Squeeze rubber rack bellows while assistant rocks tire 9-and-3 o'clock to feel inner socket knock! 2. Replace inner rack ends + new boot clamps & align.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Power Steering High-Pressure Hose Burst / Weeping at Crimp
phContext: Older hydraulic-PS cars/vans; oil spraying onto hot exhaust!
symptoms: Sudden loss of assist, smoke from hood, empty PS reservoir
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect high-pressure rubber-to-steel crimped hose from pump to rack! 2. Replace leaking hose (never use low-pressure clamps on 1,200 psi high-pressure line!).

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Steering Wheel Slow to Return After Turn — Seized Ball Joint / Caster
phContext: Cars after DIY ball-joint/strut replacement
symptoms: Must manually unwind steering wheel after every U-turn!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check lower ball joints & upper strut bearings for binding! 2. Check alignment caster angle (low/negative caster kills self-centering!). 3. Check over-tightened rack guide.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: PS Pump Pulley Belt Slipping Only at Full Lock — Relief Pressure
phContext: Older hydraulic-PS cars; 1,200+ psi stall pressure at full lock
symptoms: Loud screech when holding wheel all the way left/right
diagnosticSteps: 1. Never hold hydraulic steering at full lock >3 seconds! 2. Tighten/replace glazed PS belt.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Rear Camber Too Negative ('Stance' Sag) — Worn Rear Control Arms
phContext: Older CR-V, Civic, Camry, Territory; worn rear upper camber arms
symptoms: Rear tires leaning inward at top (/ \), bald inner edges
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect rear upper control arm bushings & sagging coil springs. 2. Install adjustable rear camber arms if needed and align.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Steering Column Tilt/Telescopic Lever Won't Lock — Stripped Wedge
phContext: High-mileage taxis/vans; worn column lock clamp
symptoms: Steering wheel drops down while driving!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect under-column tilt clamping nut/bolt and tighten or replace worn serrated lock plate.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: EPS Rack Mounting Bushings Torn — Whole Rack Shifts Left/Right
phContext: Older pickups/SUVs; oil-soaked rubber steering rack clamp bushings
symptoms: Delayed steering response, clunk on turn-in
diagnosticSteps: 1. Watch steering rack body while assistant turns wheel on ground (if entire rack slides sideways 5+ mm, replace polyurethane/rubber rack mount bushings!).

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Thrust Angle Off — Bent Rear Torsion Beam / Trailing Arm
phContext: FWD sedans hit curb/pothole with rear wheel
symptoms: Car drives straight with crooked wheel, dog-tracking
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 4-wheel alignment Rear Toe & Thrust Angle! (Front alignment alone cannot fix a bent rear axle!). 2. Shim hub (if shim-adjustable) or replace bent rear beam.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Steering Fluid Boiling — Missing PS Oil Cooler Loop
phContext: Pickups/SUVs doing heavy off-road/mountain switchbacks
symptoms: PS fluid foams out cap hot
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify factory steel cooling loop behind front grille/radiator isn't bypassed or clogged with mud. 2. Flush PSF.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Aftermarket Deep-Dish / High-Offset Rims Causing Scrub Radius Pull
phContext: Modified pickups/cars with wide negative-offset wheels
symptoms: Heavy steering, tramlining on road ruts, premature wheel bearing wear
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check wheel offset (ET) vs. OEM spec; excessive negative offset increases scrub radius & bearing load. 2. Align toe slightly inward to stabilize.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Steering Damper (Shock) Leaking — Jimny/4x4 Shimmy
phContext: Solid-axle 4x4s (Jimny, older Land Cruiser/Patrol)
symptoms: Steering kicks back hard over rocks/bumps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unbolt one end of steering damper and stroke by hand (dead spots = blown damper!). 2. Replace damper & check track bar.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Car Pulls ONLY Under Acceleration, Pulls Opposite Braking — Arm Bushing
phContext: FWD cars; severely torn lower control arm rear bushing
symptoms: Torque-steer pull on gas, darting opposite way on brakes
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect lower control arm bushings for complete rubber tear! 2. Replace arms & align.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Wrong Alignment Specs Selected at Shop (Wrong Model/Year)
phContext: Shop selects generic 'Vios' or RHD spec on alignment machine!
symptoms: Steering crooked or tire wear despite 'green' printout
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify exact year, chassis code, LHD Philippines spec, and ride height on alignment printout!

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: PS Pump Shaft Seal Sucking Air (No Oil Leak!) — Foamy Fluid
phContext: Hydraulic-PS cars; hard rubber front shaft seal
symptoms: Whine cold, pink foam in reservoir, zero puddle on floor!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pump suction draws air IN past worn shaft seal without leaking oil OUT when running! 2. Replace PS pump shaft seal / rebuild pump.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Knuckle / Spindle Bent From Pothole — Unadjustable Camber
phContext: Cars hitting deep uncovered manhole
symptoms: One front wheel visibly tilted, eats tire in 2,000 km
diagnosticSteps: 1. Compare left vs. right camber & SAI (Steering Axis Inclination) on alignment machine! 2. Replace bent steering knuckle/strut.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Camber Bolts / Eccentrics Slipped — Loud Clunk After Alignment
phContext: Pickups/SUVs (Hilux, Fortuner, Montero); under-torqued cam bolts
symptoms: Alignment goes crooked 1 week after shop visit!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Torque lower control arm cam bolts to full OEM spec (130–180 N·m) with vehicle weight on wheels!

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Steering Wheel Shakes ONLY at 110+ km/h — Rear Wheel Balance!
phContext: Expressway commuters; front wheels balanced, rear ignored
symptoms: Seat/floor vibration above 100 km/h
diagnosticSteps: 1. Dynamic balance ALL 4 wheels (and check for mud caked inside rear rim barrels!).

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: EPS Motor Overcurrent Trip on Ice/Mud/Curb — Pinched Tire
phContext: Parallel-parked EPS car with front tire jammed hard against curb
symptoms: EPS warning light, temporary assist cut
diagnosticSteps: 1. Straighten wheel off curb, cycle ignition, and verify EPS recovers cleanly.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Tie-Rod Boot Twisted Shut After Alignment — Tears in 1 Month!
phContext: Alignment shop turned inner tie-rod hex without loosening boot clamp!
symptoms: New rack boot twisted like a candy wrapper & torn!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always loosen outer rubber clamp on steering rack boot before adjusting toe, then re-clamp straight!

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Hydraulic PS Pressure Switch Leaking Fluid Into Harness
phContext: Nissan/Toyota hydraulic-PS; fluid wicking up wire to ECM!
symptoms: PS fluid dripping out of ECM connector or stalling at idle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace leaking PS pressure switch and clean connector.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Uneven Ride Height Left-to-Right — Broken Coil Spring Tip
phContext: Older sedans/MPVs; top/bottom 2 inches of coil spring snapped
symptoms: One corner sits 2 cm lower, metallic clink over bumps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Reach into spring perch and inspect top & bottom coil ends for fresh rust-break! 2. Replace coil springs in pairs.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Ball Joint Dust Boot Punctured by Prybar During Service
phContext: Careless shop separating ball joint with pickle fork
symptoms: New ball joint fails in 6 months from water entry
diagnosticSteps: 1. Use proper puller/press instead of pickle fork when reusing joints; replace torn rubber boot immediately.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Steering Rack Centering Off — More Turns Left Than Right!
phContext: Cars after rack replacement where intermediate shaft was splined off
symptoms: Car turns tighter left than right, clock spring snaps!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Count exact turns lock-to-lock, center steering rack dead middle BEFORE sliding steering shaft & centering steering wheel!

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Wheel Hub Flange Bent — Rotor Runout Keeps Returning!
phContext: Cars that hit curb hard; bent wheel hub face
symptoms: New brake rotors warp again every 3,000 km!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure bare wheel hub face runout with dial indicator (<0.03 mm) before bolting new rotor on! 2. Replace bent hub.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Rusted Wheel Hub Face Causing Rotor Runout & Vibration
phContext: Coastal/flooded cars; flaky rust under brake rotor hat
symptoms: Brake pulsation right after new rotors installed!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Wire-brush/sand bare wheel hub mounting face & wheel center bore completely flat and rust-free before mounting rotor!

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Power Steering Reservoir Cap Vent Plugged — Fluid Pushes Out
phContext: Older cars; clogged pinhole in PS cap
symptoms: PS fluid weeps around cap seam
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean tiny vent pinhole in PS reservoir cap.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: 4x4 Idler Arm Bracket Bent — Front End Pull & Toe Change
phContext: Older pickups hitting off-road rocks
symptoms: Steering wanders, toe changes under braking
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect idler arm frame bracket for bends; replace idler arm.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Lower Control Arm Ball Joint Pressing Loose in Arm Bore
phContext: Stamped steel arms where ball joint pressed out/in 3x
symptoms: Clunking even with brand new ball joint!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace complete lower control arm assembly if ball-joint press bore has stretched loose!

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Steering Column Bearing Dry — Squeaking Plastic Rub Behind Wheel
phContext: Hot parked cars; dry upper/lower column bearing or rubber boot
symptoms: Rubber squeak turning wheel inside cabin
diagnosticSteps: 1. Spray dry silicone lube on firewall steering-shaft rubber boot & upper column bearing.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Tire Directional Arrow Mounted Backwards — Hydroplaning in Rain
phContext: Directional tires mounted opposite after vulcanizing patch
symptoms: Poor wet traction, loud tire roar
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 'ROTATION ->' arrow or 'OUTSIDE' sidewall stamp on all 4 tires! 2. Remount correctly.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Spare Donut Tire Left on Front Drive Axle — Diff & ABS Stress
phContext: Cars driving weeks on small temporary spare on front axle
symptoms: Pulls hard, ABS/ESC light on, transmission diff wear!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always mount full-size tire on front drive axle (move good rear tire to front, put donut spare on rear temporarily!) and keep <80 km/h.

domainName: Steering Rack, Hydraulic Power Steering & Wheel Alignment Geometry
title: Post-Alignment Steering Angle Sensor (SAS) Not Reset — ESC Trips
phContext: Any modern ESC/VSC car aligned without scan tool reset
symptoms: Stability control brakes one wheel on gentle highway curve!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always run SAS Zero-Point Calibration immediately after every 4-wheel alignment!

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Collapsed Rubber Brake Hose Acting as One-Way Check Valve!
phContext: 8+ year old cars; rusty steel crimp crimping inner rubber liner shut
symptoms: One wheel stays locked hot; cracking bleeder squirts fluid & frees wheel!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Raise dragging wheel: open bleeder screw (if wheel spins free immediately, rubber brake hose is collapsed internally!). 2. Replace front/rear flexible brake hoses in pairs.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Brake Pad Hardware Clips Rubbing Rotor Hat — Loud Scrape!
phContext: Cars right after DIY brake pad change; bent stainless abutment clip
symptoms: Continuous metallic scraping noise matching wheel speed
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull wheel and inspect stainless pad retainer clips for contact against rotor edge/hat! 2. Clean rust under clips before snapping them in.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Rear Wheel Cylinder Leaking Brake Fluid Into Drum — Grabbing Wheel
phContext: Vios, Mirage, Innova, L300, Hilux rear drums; torn rubber boots
symptoms: One rear wheel locks up suddenly on light braking!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull rear brake drum and peel back rubber wheel cylinder dust boots (wet fluid = leaking cup seal!). 2. Replace wheel cylinders in pairs + oil-soaked shoes.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Rear Drum Auto-Adjuster Seized — Low Pedal & Weak Handbrake
phContext: Sedans/pickups; rusted star-wheel adjuster
symptoms: Brake pedal travels far down, handbrake pulls 10+ clicks
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disassemble star-wheel adjuster, wire-brush threads, apply anti-seize, and adjust shoes until slight drag when sliding drum on!

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: New Brake Master Cylinder Never Bench-Bled — Permanently Spongy!
phContext: Shop bolted dry master cylinder straight onto booster and bled wheels
symptoms: Pedal stays spongy even after 2 liters of fluid bled at wheels!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Air trapped at top of angled master cylinder bore won't bleed out wheel lines! 2. Bench-bleed master cylinder using return tubes until zero bubbles, then install.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Brake Caliper Piston Boot Torn — Rust Seizing Piston
phContext: Flood-crossed vehicles; torn rubber dust boot around caliper piston
symptoms: Dragging brake, overheating rotor, pulling to one side
diagnosticSteps: 1. Press/inspect caliper piston dust boot: rusted/pitted piston binds in bore! 2. Rebuild caliper with new piston/seal kit or replace caliper.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Wrong Grease on Caliper Slide Pins — Swollen Rubber Bushings!
phContext: Shop used petroleum chassis grease instead of silicone brake pin grease!
symptoms: Rubber sleeve on slide pin swells 2x size and locks caliper solid!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Petroleum grease swells EPDM brake rubber! 2. Clean bores, install new rubber bushings, and use ONLY silicone/synthetic brake caliper grease (e.g., Sil-Glyde/Permatex).

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Brake Booster Check Valve Backwards or Stuck — No Power Assist
phContext: Cars after engine/hose work; white/black inline check valve
symptoms: Rock-hard pedal right after engine work
diagnosticSteps: 1. Blow through inline check valve: arrow must point toward intake manifold/vacuum pump! 2. Replace stuck valve.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Steel Brake Line Rusted Pinhole Under Plastic Clip — Sudden Pedal Loss
phContext: Coastal/flooded 10+ year old cars; moisture trapped in frame clips
symptoms: Sudden brake warning light, pedal drops to floor, wet spot under rail
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect steel brake lines under plastic frame clips & rear axle T-block for deep rust! 2. Replace with copper-nickel (CuNiFer) or OEM flared steel line (NEVER use compression fittings on brakes!).

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Brake Pad Installed Backwards (Metal Backing Against Rotor!) — Grind
phContext: Rushed roadside pad slap
symptoms: Horrible metal grind immediately after brake service
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull wheel and verify friction material faces rotor on both inner & outer pads! 2. Replace ruined rotor & pads.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Drum-in-Hat Parking Brake Shoes Separated — Grinding in Rear Hub
phContext: SUVs with rear disc brakes + internal drum parking brake (Fortuner, Montero)
symptoms: Loud clunk/grind inside rear hub, wheel locks in Reverse
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull rear brake rotor-hat to inspect internal parking brake shoes (lining often delaminates from rust!). 2. Replace parking shoes & hardware.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Brake Fluid Reservoir Cap Diaphragm Torn — Moisture Absorbed
phContext: Older cars; swollen/torn black rubber bellows under reservoir cap
symptoms: Dark murky brake fluid every 6 months, spongy pedal
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect reservoir cap rubber seal & clean vent; flush fluid with DOT4.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Anti-Rattle / Pad Shims Left Out — Loud Clack Braking in Reverse
phContext: Cars after budget pad replacement without shims
symptoms: Sharp metallic click when first applying brakes in Reverse or Drive
diagnosticSteps: 1. Install OEM stainless pad shims and abutment clips so pads don't shift in bracket.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Brake Bleeder Screw Snapped Flush in Caliper — Seized Rust
phContext: Old calipers; rusted 8mm/10mm bleeder twisted too hard
symptoms: Cannot bleed brake caliper
diagnosticSteps: 1. Use 6-point socket + penetrating oil/heat carefully on bleeder screws! 2. Extract broken screw with left-hand drill/extractor or replace caliper.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Parking Brake Cable Frozen Inside Sheath — Rear Wheel Stays Locked
phContext: Cars parked with handbrake pulled for weeks after driving through flood!
symptoms: Handbrake lever goes slack, yet rear wheel stays locked!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect parking brake cable at rear drum/caliper lever to see if wheel frees! 2. Replace rusted parking brake cable.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Cheap Aftermarket Brake Pads Squealing & Dusting Heavily
phContext: Hard metallic P400 pads with poor chamfer/slotting
symptoms: Ear-piercing squeal at every light stop
diagnosticSteps: 1. Install quality ceramic/low-metallic OEM-spec pads with chamfered edges + backing shims + caliper grease on contact ears.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Brake Pedal Return Spring Missing / Weak — Brake Lights Flicker
phContext: Older cars; heavy pedal resting slightly on brake switch
symptoms: Brake lights stay on or flicker over bumps, cruise drops out
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect pedal return spring and adjust brake light switch clearance.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Rear Disc Caliper Twist-In Piston Forced Straight — Ruined Internal Screw
phContext: Manual-handbrake rear disc calipers (Civic, Mazda 3, Fiesta, Territory)
symptoms: Handbrake doesn't hold after rear pad change!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Rear calipers with integrated parking brake lever MUST be rotated/screwed inward while pressing (or EPB retracted electronically) — never forced straight! 2. Replace ruined caliper.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Brake Rotor Minimum Thickness Exceeded ('Manipis Na!') — Overheating
phContext: Cars with rotors resurfaced 3+ times below 'MIN TH' stamp
symptoms: Pedal fades rapidly in traffic, rotor cracks/warps immediately
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure rotor thickness with micrometer and compare to 'MIN TH' stamped on rotor hat! 2. Replace thin rotors rather than machining again.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: ABS Hydraulic Unit Air-Locked After Master/Line Run Dry
phContext: Cars where reservoir ran completely dry during brake job
symptoms: Pedal still soft after manual bleeding all 4 corners
diagnosticSteps: 1. Air trapped inside ABS HCU solenoid chambers! 2. Run scan-tool Automated ABS Bleed routine while pressure-bleeding each corner.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Brake Fluid Level Switch Stuck Low — Red Brake Light On
phContext: Cars with full reservoir yet red (!) brake warning light stays on
symptoms: Red brake light solid despite handbrake down & full fluid
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug 2-pin fluid level sensor on reservoir (if light goes out, magnetic float inside reservoir is waterlogged/sunk!). 2. Tap float or replace reservoir.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Banjo Bolt Copper Washers Reused — Slow Leak at Caliper
phContext: Cars after caliper replacement; weeping brake fluid at hose bolt
symptoms: Wet brake fluid around caliper hose fitting, soft pedal
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always use TWO brand-new copper crush washers (one each side of hose banjo block) and torque to spec!

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Brake Pad Wear Indicator Squealer Tab Bent — Squeals With Thick Pads!
phContext: New pads where thin metal wear tab got bent toward rotor
symptoms: Constant high-pitched squeal driving straight even with 90% pad left
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull wheel and check thin metal wear-indicator tab clearance from rotor face! 2. Bend clear or seat pad properly.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Heavy Brake Fade Descending Baguio / Tagaytay — Riding Brakes
phContext: AT/CVT drivers staying in 'D' holding brake pedal 20 min downhill
symptoms: Smoking brakes, pedal goes to floor, terrifying loss of stopping power
diagnosticSteps: 1. Educate driver to shift to S/L/M2/B-mode for engine braking! 2. Flush boiled DOT3/4 fluid and inspect glazed pads/blue rotors.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Rear Drum Out-of-Round — Pulsating Pedal & Grabbing
phContext: Older pickups/vans; warped/dropped brake drum
symptoms: Brake pedal surges up/down at low speed, handbrake pulses
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure rear drum inner diameter & runout on brake lathe (replace if past MAX DIA!).

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Diesel Vacuum Pump Oil-Starved — Sudden Hard Brake Pedal
phContext: Pickups/vans; clogged oil feed to alternator vacuum pump
symptoms: Pedal rock-hard, vacuum gauge reads 0 kPa
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check vacuum pump oil feed line & pump vanes. 2. Replace pump.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Dual-Piston Caliper — One Piston Seized, Pad Worn Tapered
phContext: SUVs/pickups (Fortuner, Hilux, Montero, Ranger) with 2/4-piston calipers
symptoms: Pulls on braking, pad worn wedge-shaped top-to-bottom
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect all pistons for smooth retraction and torn boots. 2. Rebuild caliper & replace tapered pads.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Brake Line Twisted Like Spiral During Caliper Reinstall
phContext: Careless pad swap where caliper was flipped 360° before bolting!
symptoms: Kinked rubber brake hose, dragging brake
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check rubber brake hose routing: stripe/rib on hose must run straight without twisting! 2. Unbolt caliper, untwist, and re-bolt.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: EPB Rear Caliper Connector Broken Latch — Vibrates Loose
phContext: Electronic Parking Brake SUVs/sedans
symptoms: Intermittent EPB fault light over bumps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect 2-pin EPB plug on rear caliper for broken locking tab. 2. Replace pigtail connector housing.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Brake Dust Shield Bent Rubbing Rotor — Post-Tire Change
phContext: Thin stamped backing plate bent by tire shop/rock
symptoms: Loud tinny scraping noise only when turning or driving
diagnosticSteps: 1. Reach behind rotor and bend thin steel dust shield 5 mm clear of rotor back face!

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Master Cylinder Reservoir Grommets Weeping — Fluid on Booster
phContext: Older cars; hardened rubber grommets where plastic tank sits on master
symptoms: Paint peeling off front of black brake booster!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Brake fluid eats paint! Replace leaking reservoir grommets and flush spilled fluid off booster.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Hill-Start Assist (HSA) Holding Brakes Too Long — Sticky Valve/Sensor
phContext: Manual/AT crossovers; car feels held back 3 sec on flat road
symptoms: Feels like brakes stick briefly starting from stop
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan ABS/ESC for G-sensor / pitch sensor zero-point offset! 2. Perform G-sensor calibration on level ground.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Brake Caliper Slide Pin Seized Solid in Bracket — Torch Needed
phContext: Flood-exposed cars; rusted dry lower slide pin
symptoms: Inner pad worn to metal while outer pad looks brand new
diagnosticSteps: 1. Free seized pin carefully, hone bracket bore clean, replace pin & rubber boot, and grease with silicone.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Proportioning Valve Bypassed / Incorrect After Rear Disc Swap
phContext: Modified Civic/Vios swapped from rear drums to rear discs without prop valve
symptoms: Rear wheels lock up dangerously in rain before front wheels!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Install matching rear-disc proportioning valve (or verify EBD ABS calibration) when converting drum-to-disc!

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Brake Booster Vacuum Hose Collapsed Internally — Delayed Assist
phContext: Older cars using soft non-vacuum-rated hose on booster
symptoms: Hard pedal for 1st second, then assist kicks in
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace with thick-walled SAE J1403 vacuum hose.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Parking Brake Shoe Anchor Pin Bent — Grinding Inside Drum
phContext: SUVs driven briefly with handbrake partially pulled
symptoms: Clanking noise in rear wheel
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull rear drum/rotor and inspect bent hold-down pins & clips. 2. Replace hardware kit.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Brake Pedal Squeak at Pivot — Dry Plastic Bushings
phContext: High-mileage commuters
symptoms: Squeak inside cabin every brake press
diagnosticSteps: 1. Lubricate brake pedal pivot bolt & clevis pin with white lithium/silicone grease.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: DOT5 Silicone vs. DOT3/4 Glycol Fluid Mixed — Gel Sludge!
phContext: Someone poured purple DOT5 silicone into DOT3/4 system!
symptoms: Swollen rubber seals, gelled sludge plugging ABS valves!
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER mix DOT5 (silicone) with DOT3/4/5.1 (glycol)! 2. Flush entire system, rebuild master/calipers.

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Brake Rotor Hat Rust-Seized to Wheel Hub — Impossible to Pull
phContext: Coastal/flooded vehicles
symptoms: Rotor won't budge after removing caliper
diagnosticSteps: 1. Thread two M8 bolts into the threaded 'jacking holes' on the rotor hat evenly to pop rotor off hub cleanly (never hammer rotor edge if reusing!).

domainName: Braking Hydraulics, Drum/Disc Mechanics & Parking Brake Systems
title: Bed-In / Burnishing Skipped After New Pads & Rotors — Judder
phContext: Customer slams brakes hard leaving shop on brand-new pads
symptoms: Uneven pad transfer film causing immediate brake pulsation
diagnosticSteps: 1. Perform proper bed-in: 5–8 moderate stops from 60->15 km/h without coming to complete dead stop holding hot pad on rotor!

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: UDS Security Access Denied — Wrong Seed-Key or Lockout Timer
phContext: Modern UDS (ISO 14229) ECUs during coding/DPF/immo routines
symptoms: Diagnostic tool fails routine with 'Security Access Denied (0x33)'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify correct OEM Seed-Key algorithm for target ECU generation. 2. Wait 10–15 min with key ON if 3 wrong attempts triggered lockout timer. 3. Retry.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: UDS Conditions Not Correct — Engine Running / Voltage / Speed
phContext: Performing injector coding, SAS reset, or flash while engine runs
symptoms: Routine aborts with 'Conditions Not Correct (0x22)'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check prerequisites: Key ON Engine OFF (or hot >80°C for idle learn), Park/Neutral, Vehicle Speed = 0 km/h, Battery >12.5V! 2. Re-run routine.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: UDS Request Out Of Range — Unsupported PID / Wrong Variant
phContext: Writing coding bytes or requesting PID not supported by trim level
symptoms: Tool returns 'Request Out Of Range (0x31)'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify ECU part number & software calibration ID match target vehicle (e.g., 2WD vs. 4WD, MT vs. AT). 2. Use valid DID/RID.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: UDS Response Pending Timeout — Slow Flash / EEPROM Erase
phContext: Flashing ECM/TCM over K-Line or CAN; tool times out too early
symptoms: Flash fails mid-write with timeout error
diagnosticSteps: 1. Ensure VCI/app respects NRC 0x78 (Response Pending) and extends P2* timeout to 5,000+ ms during flash erase! 2. Maintain 13.5V+ charger.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Security Gateway (SGW) Blocking Bi-Directional Controls
phContext: 2020+ FCA/Nissan/Renault/Hyun dai/BYD/Geely with SGW module
symptoms: Can read DTCs & freeze frame, cannot clear codes or actuate tests!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if vehicle routes OBD-II DLC through SGW firewall! 2. Use SGW-authenticated session or OEM-authorized SGW bypass cable directly on CAN-C/B.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: DoIP (Diagnostics over IP) Port Not Responding — Pin 8 Activation
phContext: 2022+ Land Rover, Volvo, BYD, Mercedes, BMW Ethernet diagnostics
symptoms: CAN works slowly or fails, DoIP Ethernet link stays down
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check DLC Pin 8 (Ethernet Activation Line: needs 5V/12V pull-up from VCI!) and differential pairs Pins 3/11 (RX) & 12/13 (TX). 2. Verify DoIP cable.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: SAE J1939 PGN / SPN Multi-Packet (BAM / RTS-CTS) Dropped
phContext: 24V Hino/Isuzu/Fuso/Cummins trucks; reading DM1/DM2 active faults
symptoms: Heavy-duty scanner misses long fault list or VIN
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify VCI supports J1939 Transport Protocol (TP.CM BAM & RTS/CTS 250/500 kbps)! 2. Check 60-ohm J1939 bus termination.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: CAN-FD (Flexible Data-Rate) Not Supported by Legacy J2534 VCI
phContext: 2023+ Ford, GM, Hyundai, BYD using 2 Mbps / 5 Mbps CAN-FD
symptoms: Older J2534-1 interface fails completely to detect newer modules!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify vehicle uses CAN-FD (ISO 11898-1:2015) vs. Classic CAN. 2. Use CAN-FD capable VCI hardware.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: MOST Fiber-Optic Ring Break — Audio / Cluster / Nav Dead
phContext: Luxury European/Asian SUVs (BMW, Mercedes, Audi, Lexus) with orange fiber
symptoms: Infotainment dead, screen blank, amplifier silent
diagnosticSteps: 1. Look into orange fiber-optic connector at amplifier/head unit (working module emits bright red LED light!). 2. Use MOST fiber bypass loop to isolate dead module.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: CAN Bus Sleep / Wake-Up Loop — Stuck Module Keeping Bus Awake
phContext: Modern CAN cars with overnight battery drain
symptoms: Modules wake up every 10 seconds even with key off & doors locked
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope CAN-H while locked (should drop to 0.0V flat asleep after 2–5 min!). 2. Unplug suspect modules (BCM, TCU, Door, Telematics) until CAN stays asleep at 0V.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Medium Speed CAN (MS-CAN) Bus Off — Ford Pins 3 & 11
phContext: Ford Ranger, Everest, EcoSport, Fiesta (500k HS-CAN + 125k MS-CAN)
symptoms: Audio, HVAC, or BCM dead while Engine/ABS scan fine!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check DLC Pins 3 (+) and 11 (-) for 60 ohms & 2.5V! 2. Remember MS-CAN is separate from HS-CAN (Pins 6/14); inspect HVAC/ACM/BCM connectors.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Single-Wire CAN (SWCAN / GMLAN Pin 1) Open or Shorted
phContext: Chevrolet Trailblazer, Colorado, Spark, Captiva (33.3 kbps SWCAN)
symptoms: Body/cluster/radio dead while ECM scans on Pins 6/14
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check DLC Pin 1 (SWCAN) voltage (0V asleep, ~0–4V active, 12V high-voltage wake-up!). 2. Trace Pin 1 splice to BCM.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: ISO 15765-4 Flow Control (FC) Frame Missed — Wrong Tester Address
phContext: App-to-ECU multi-frame PID/VIN read fails after 1st frame
symptoms: First 7 bytes arrive, rest of VIN/DTC list hangs
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check ISO-TP Flow Control (0x30) timing (STmin / BS) and functional vs. physical addressing (0x7DF vs. 0x7E0)! 2. Adjust VCI filter mask.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Lost Comm with Gateway Module A — Central Gateway Water
phContext: Modern vehicles with dedicated Central Gateway (CGW/ZGW) under dash
symptoms: No modules respond to scan tool at OBD-II port!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check Gateway 12V B+, IG1, and ground! (If Gateway dies, OBD-II DLC is isolated from all internal CAN buses!). 2. Inspect under-dash cowl for leaks.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: 29-Bit Extended CAN ID vs. 11-Bit Standard CAN ID Mismatch
phContext: Honda, Heavy-Duty J1939, some Chinese EVs using 29-bit CAN IDs
symptoms: Generic 11-bit OBD scanner fails to connect to Honda/EV
diagnosticSteps: 1. Enable 29-bit CAN ID scanning (0x18DB33F1 / 0x18DA10F1) in diagnostic app! 2. Check baud rate (250k vs. 500k).

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: TesterPresent (0x3E) Missing — Diagnostic Session Drops Out
phContext: Active bi-directional test (injector/fan/bleed) stops after 5 seconds
symptoms: Actuator test kicks back to normal automatically mid-test
diagnosticSteps: 1. Diagnostic app must transmit UDS TesterPresent (0x3E 0x00 / 0x80) every 2 seconds to keep Extended Diagnostic Session (0x03) alive!

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Vehicle Communication Bus B Off — Body/Interior CAN Short
phContext: Crossovers/SUVs; crushed seat-track or door-sill Body CAN wire
symptoms: Windows, A/C, and interior lights dead while engine runs fine
diagnosticSteps: 1. Locate Body CAN star connector (often at kick-panel) and unplug branches one by one to isolate shorted door/seat module.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: KWP2000 5-Baud Init Timing Too Fast/Slow on Older Asian ECUs
phContext: 2001–2008 Mitsubishi/Toyota/Hyundai /Suzuki K-Line ECUs
symptoms: Scan tool connects 1 out of 10 tries
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify strict 5-baud (200 ms per bit) byte timing and W1–W4 inter-byte delays per ISO 14230-2! 2. Check battery voltage >12.0V.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: 120-Ohm Terminating Resistor Missing After ECU Replacement
phContext: Aftermarket/standalone ECU or wrong-variant cluster installed
symptoms: CAN bus ringing & random U-codes at high RPM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure Pin 6 to Pin 14 key-off: if 120 Ω instead of 60 Ω, check which end-node resistor is missing and add 120 Ω 1/4W resistor across CAN-H/L.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: FlexRay Bus Fault (BMW / Mercedes / Luxury) — Star Coupler
phContext: High-end European SUVs in PH; 10 Mbps deterministic chassis bus
symptoms: EPS, dampers, and stability all fail simultaneously
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check FlexRay differential impedance (90–110 ohms) and inspect water-damaged star coupler/chassis ECU.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Invalid Data Received from Instrument Panel — Cluster Odometer Mismatch
phContext: Used cluster swapped without matching mileage/VIN
symptoms: Tamper dot lit on dash, U0423 in BCM/ABS
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify cluster VIN & mileage match BCM/ECM. 2. Code/virginize replacement cluster.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: LIN Bus Master Pull-Up Diode Open — Entire LIN Branch Dead
phContext: BCM/ECM LIN master internal 1 kΩ pull-up to 12V failed
symptoms: LIN wire reads 0V even with all slaves unplugged!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug all LIN slaves: healthy master holds LIN wire at ~11–12V via 1 kΩ pull-up! 2. If 0V with slaves unplugged, master ECU pull-up failed.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: OBD-II Mode $09 VIN / CalID Returns Garbled Bytes — Padding
phContext: Some Asian ECUs padding VIN strings with 0x00 or 0xFF
symptoms: Diagnostic app crashes or displays garbage VIN
diagnosticSteps: 1. Strip null/0xFF padding bytes and validate 17-character alphanumeric ISO 3779 VIN format in app parser!

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Lost Comm with Remote Function Actuation (RFA) — Keyless ECU
phContext: Push-start SUVs/sedans; RFA module in trunk/roof wet
symptoms: Smart key dead, U0214 in BCM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Locate RFA/KVM module (often rear quarter panel) and check for tailgate water leak. 2. Check 12V/GND/CAN.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: CAN-H and CAN-L Wires Swapped During Harness Repair!
phContext: Technician spliced cut harness reversing green & white CAN wires
symptoms: Total bus off (U0073) right after harness repair!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify CAN-H (~2.6–3.5V) and CAN-L (~1.5–2.4V) polarity! Swapped pair inverts differential voltage and kills the bus!

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Lost Comm with Multi-Axis Acceleration Sensor — Center Console
phContext: Toyota/Ford/Nissan; spilled drink on yaw/G-sensor under console
symptoms: VSC/ESC light on, U0125
diagnosticSteps: 1. Lift center console and inspect G-sensor plug for sticky liquid/corrosion. 2. Check 12V/5V/CAN.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: J2534 VCI Pin 12/13 Toyota Techstream 'Ts/Cg' Shorting Conflict
phContext: Using generic J2534 vs. Mini-VCI on older Toyotas
symptoms: ABS/VSC lights blink continuously ONLY while VCI is plugged in!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Some cheap cables pull Pin 13 (TC) or Pin 12 (TS) low, putting Toyota ABS/SRS into blink-code diagnostic mode! 2. Unplug cable & verify normal operation.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Lost Comm with All-Terrain Control Module — 4WD Dial
phContext: Pickups/SUVs with electronic terrain dial
symptoms: Terrain modes unavailable
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check console switch 12V/GND/CAN and spilled liquid.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: OBD-II Pin 4 (Chassis GND) vs. Pin 5 (Signal GND) Open — VCI Noise
phContext: Cars with corroded Pin 5 ground splice
symptoms: Scan tool drops packets or disconnects when engine starts
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure resistance from DLC Pin 4 and Pin 5 to battery (-) (both must be <0.5 Ω!). 2. Repair open Pin 5 ground.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Lost Comm with Vehicle Security Control Module
phContext: Hyundai/Kia/Ford; immobilizer module unplugged/dead
symptoms: No-start, security light error
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check IMMO fuse, ground, and LIN/CAN link to ECM.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Ethernet / USB EMI Dropping VCI Connection Near Spark Plugs
phContext: Testing older distributor/waste-spark cars with unshielded USB cable
symptoms: VCI disconnects every time engine revs!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Route VCI cable away from high-voltage ignition wires/coils and use ferrite-choked shielded USB cable!

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Invalid Data Received from Brake System Control Module
phContext: ECM/TCM/ADAS flagging bad brake data
symptoms: Multiple warnings, U0418
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan ABS/ESC module for primary brake pressure or wheel speed DTCs.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: CAN Bus Voltage Stuck at 12V — Shorted to Battery Positive
phContext: Melted harness near starter/alternator B+ wire
symptoms: CAN-H and/or CAN-L reads 12.0V! Zero comm
diagnosticSteps: 1. Key ON: measure Pin 6 & Pin 14 to GND. >5V on either pin = shorted to 12V! 2. Trace melted harness.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: CAN Bus Voltage Stuck at 0V — Shorted to Ground
phContext: Pinched harness under seat rail or firewall grommet
symptoms: Pin 6 or Pin 14 reads 0.0V at KOEO! Zero comm
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure Pin 6 & 14 to GND key-off (ohms): <10 Ω to ground = dead short! 2. Unplug branches to isolate.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Lost Comm with Reductant (AdBlue) Control Module
phContext: Euro-5/6 diesels; underbody DEF module submerged in flood
symptoms: AdBlue countdown warning, U010E
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect DEF control module near tank for water ingress & blown 15A/20A fuse.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Baud Rate Auto-Detect Fails on Mixed 250k / 500k Fleet
phContext: 24V commercial trucks (some use 250k J1939, newer use 500k J1939)
symptoms: VCI fails to detect truck ECU
diagnosticSteps: 1. Manually toggle J1939 baud rate between 250 kbps and 500 kbps in app settings!

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Lost Comm with Door Control Module B (Passenger)
phContext: Modern SUVs/sedans; broken wire in passenger door boot
symptoms: Passenger mirror/window/lock dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect passenger A-pillar rubber door boot for broken CAN/power wires.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Broadcast / Sniffing Mode Shows Zero Frames — Missing Wake-Up
phContext: Bench testing BCM/Cluster that sleeps until Ignition/Wake frame sent
symptoms: Bench module draws 5 mA and stays silent on CAN
diagnosticSteps: 1. Send OEM wake-up CAN ID (or apply 12V to KL15 / Wake-up pin) to wake sleeping module on bench!

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Invalid Data Received from Gateway A
phContext: Sub-modules complaining about corrupted gateway relay
symptoms: Erratic cluster warnings
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check Gateway 12V/GND and inspect for water/OTA corruption.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Diagnostic Trouble Code Status Byte Misread (Pending vs. Confirmed)
phContext: App showing historical/test-not-completed codes as active!
symptoms: Technician replaces parts for old 'History' code!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Parse UDS/OBD Status Byte (0x08 Confirmed, 0x04 Pending, 0x01 TestFailed, 0x20 TestFailedSinceLastClear) accurately!

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Lost Comm with Brake System Control Module (Heavy Duty J1939)
phContext: 24V trucks/buses; WABCO/Knorr ABS ECU power/CAN
symptoms: ABS + Retarder off, U0129 / SPN 639
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 24V ABS fuses (both ECU & Modulator) and J1939 twisted pair.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: K-Line Pulled High to 24V on Commercial Truck — Destroys 12V VCI!
phContext: 24V trucks with 24V K-Line / J1708 levels
symptoms: 12V-only ELM/VCI burns out on 24V truck!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify VCI hardware is rated for 24V–32V input before plugging into Isuzu/Hino/Fuso 24V trucks!

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Lost Comm with Telematics Control Module — Unplugged GPS
phContext: Used cars where previous owner unplugged factory telematics box
symptoms: Stored U0198 / SOS warning
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check behind glovebox/dash for unplugged TCU; reconnect or code out if decommissioned.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: CAN Terminating Resistor Heated / Burned — Wrong 12V Jump
phContext: ECU CAN transceiver + 120 Ω resistor damaged by 12V short
symptoms: Bus reads 60 Ω cold, opens hot!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect SMD 120 Ω (or split 60+60 Ω) termination resistors next to CAN transceiver on ECU PCB.

domainName: Automotive Network Protocols: UDS, J1939, FlexRay, MOST & DoIP Diagnostics
title: Software Incompatibility with ECM/PCM — Mismatched Flash
phContext: After replacing used TCM/ABS/BCM with different model year
symptoms: Limp mode, U0301
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify exact hardware/calibration compatibility and flash matching OEM software.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Transponder Key Fob Not Recognized — Missing Carbon/Glass Chip
phContext: Flip keys / spare keys dropped or re-shelled by owner
symptoms: Unlocks doors fine, engine cranks and won't start (or cranks 2 sec & dies)
diagnosticSteps: 1. Open plastic key shell and check if tiny black trapezoid PCF7936/4D/8A transponder chip was left behind inside the old broken shell! 2. Test key in RF coil reader.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Smart Key Fob Transmitting Weakly — Oxidized Battery Spring Tab
phContext: 3+ year old smart keys; new CR2032 still fails intermittently
symptoms: Key Not Detected even with brand-new battery!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check CR2032 voltage under load (cheap P20 batteries read 3.0V unloaded and drop to 2.2V!). 2. Bend/clean tarnished gold battery contact tabs inside fob.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Wrong Transponder Chip Frequency / Modulation (315 vs. 433 MHz)
phContext: Owner bought cheap online smart key fob that looks identical
symptoms: Transponder starts car on button? No — fails to program at all!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify exact OEM frequency (PH uses 433.92 MHz mostly, some JDM/US imports use 315 MHz!) AND exact chip/page ID (e.g., Toyota H/8A vs. G/4D, Hitag2 vs. Hitag-AES)!

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Toyota Unmatched Key Code — Key Already Locked to Another Car!
phContext: Trying to program a used/second-hand Toyota/Hyundai smart key
symptoms: Key fails to register or triggers 'Used Key Locked' error
diagnosticSteps: 1. Modern smart keys (Hitag-AES, Toyota 8A/H, Nissan 4A) permanently lock their crypto page to the first car! 2. Unlock/renew used fob via programmer or use virgin key.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Immobilizer Antenna Coil Around Ignition Lock Open
phContext: Key-start Toyota, Honda, Mitsubishi, Hyundai; broken hair-thin copper coil
symptoms: Security light blinks fast on ALL keys including master!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure continuity across 2-pin/4-pin antenna coil ring around key cylinder (spec 2–15 ohms; open = broken!). 2. Test coil with RF induction tester ring (must blink at key-on!).

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: All-Keys-Lost (AKL) — Toyota Smart Key Box Reset vs. Emulator
phContext: 2018+ Toyota Vios/Fortuner/Hilux/Coroll a Cross AKL
symptoms: No working key to turn ignition ON for OBD programming!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Wake car via hazard lights/brake pedal; use Lonsdor/Autel/Techstream with 8A/4D simulator or read Smart Key ECU EEPROM (93C86/RH86) on bench to generate master key!

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Mitsubishi KOS (Keyless Operation System) Locked After 3 Wrong PINs
phContext: Montero, Xpander, Mirage; wrong immobilizer PIN entered
symptoms: KOS rejects valid PIN for 15+ minutes
diagnosticSteps: 1. Leave ignition ON (or hazard lights on) for 15–30 minutes without touching anything to clear security lockout timer! 2. Verify exact chassis PIN.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Ford PATS 10-Minute Security Wait Fails — Low Battery Voltage
phContext: Ford Ranger/Everest/EcoSport key programming
symptoms: Programming aborts at 9 minutes with 'Security Access Failed'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Connect stabilized 13.5V battery maintainer BEFORE starting Ford PATS 10-min timed access! 2. Minimum 2 distinct transponder keys required for PATS AKL.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Honda Smart Key / Immobilizer Sync Lost After ECM Swap
phContext: Honda City, Civic, BR-V, CR-V; used ECM installed
symptoms: Green key icon flashes rapidly on cluster, no start
diagnosticSteps: 1. Run 'ECM/PCM Replace' synchronization function via HDS/scan tool (pairs Immobilizer Unit / BCM with replacement ECM). 2. Verify green key turns off after 2 sec.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Nissan NATS PIN Code Conversion Error (Old 4-Digit vs. New 20-Digit)
phContext: Nissan Navara, Almera, Urvan, Terra; wrong PIN calculation
symptoms: NATS rejects PIN, locks ECM after 5 tries!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Match BCM label 5-digit code (old 4-digit PIN) vs. 2013+ rolling 20-digit BCM code! 2. Wait 1 hr key-on if NATS locked out.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Door Request Button Dead, Fob Buttons Work — Torn Rubber Switch
phContext: Push-start cars (Vios, Xpander, City, Montero); worn handle button
symptoms: Unlocking via fob works, pressing black button on door handle does nothing
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check Door Handle Request Switch PID in BCM while pressing button. 2. Check if trunk/other door button works (isolates torn microswitch inside driver handle!).

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: LF (125 kHz) Interior Key Antenna Dead — Must Touch Fob to Start
phContext: Push-start SUVs/MPVs; unplugged console/trunk 125 kHz antenna
symptoms: Fob unlocks doors from 10m, yet inside cabin says 'Key Not Detected'!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check LF Antenna 1/2/3 PIDs or ohm-test 2-pin interior console LF antenna coil (spec 1–5 ohms). 2. Often left unplugged during center console/stereo removal!

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Electronic Steering Lock (ESL) Motor Weak — Intermittent No-Wake
phContext: Nissan, Hyundai, Kia, Mercedes; carbon-fouled ESL DC motor
symptoms: Steering stays locked, ignition refuses to turn ON
diagnosticSteps: 1. Tap steering column lock lightly while pressing Start to test. 2. Disassemble ESL, replace worn Mabuchi DC motor (or install programmed ESL emulator).

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Remote Fob Desynchronized After Changing Coin Battery
phContext: Older fixed/rolling-code remotes (e.g., Peugeot, VW, Suzuki, Mitsubishi)
symptoms: Fob LED blinks, car ignores lock/unlock
diagnosticSteps: 1. Perform manual remote resync (e.g., turn key ON, press Lock 5 sec, or cycle key ON-OFF 6x per OEM procedure). 2. Re-register remote via OBD.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Immobilizer EEPROM Corrupted by Arc Welding / Dead Battery
phContext: Toyota/Mitsubishi/Hyundai ; EEPROM bytes wiped to 0xFF
symptoms: Key programming fails, P0605/B2799 permanent
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read 8-pin SOIC EEPROM on bench programmer; compare with known-good virgin/donor dump. 2. Transfer VIN/ISN or write virgin file and re-pair keys.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Aftermarket Metallic Window Tint Blocking Smart Key Entry!
phContext: Cars with heavy metallic/silver mirror tint on rear/front glass
symptoms: Must stand 30 cm from car for remote to lock/unlock
diagnosticSteps: 1. Metallic tint acts as a Faraday cage attenuating 315/433 MHz RF! 2. Test range with doors/windows open vs. closed to prove tint interference.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Suzuki / Maruti 4-Digit / 8-Digit Immobilizer PIN Mismatch
phContext: Suzuki Ertiga, Swift, S-Presso, Dzire; key programming
symptoms: Key registration fails on Suzuki
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read Suzuki BCM/ECM 8-digit/20-digit ID code to calculate exact dynamic PIN! 2. Verify transponder ID47/ID46/4A matches.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Hyundai / Kia 6-Digit PIN Needed From VIN / Smartra Dump
phContext: Hyundai Accent, Reina, Starex, Tucson; AKL
symptoms: Cannot program key without 6-digit PIN
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read 6-digit PIN from ECM/BCM EEPROM/Flash dump on bench or via authorized VIN-to-PIN lookup. 2. Program ID46/ID47/4A key.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Key Blade Cut Slightly Off — Turns Door, Jams Ignition Wafer!
phContext: Poorly duplicated metal emergency/valet blade
symptoms: Key turns smoothly one way, jams halfway in ignition lock
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect brass/nickel key blade shoulders & cut depths with micrometer against original! 2. Use CNC key cutter (e.g., Dolphin/Condor) by bitting code instead of worn copy.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Mercedes / BMW / VW CAS/EIS/MQB Key Programming Without Backup!
phContext: European luxury cars in PH; interrupted OBD read
symptoms: Car bricked completely after failed OBD key read!
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER attempt European CAS/FEM/EIS/MQB key programming without backing up original Flash + EEPROM on bench first and keeping 13.8V 30A+ power supply connected!

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Fob Micro-Switch Solder Joint Cracked on PCB — Drops Intermittently
phContext: Well-used flip keys; unlock button works only if squeezed hard
symptoms: LED fails to blink when pressing Lock button
diagnosticSteps: 1. Open fob shell and inspect SMD tactile button legs under magnifier for cracked solder joints! 2. Reflow or solder new SMD micro-switch.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Chinese Brand (Geely / Chery / MG / BYD) Smart Key PIN Required
phContext: Geely Coolray, MG ZS, Chery Tiggo, BYD; AKL
symptoms: Diagnostic tool asks for 4/8/16-digit security PIN
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read BCM/PEPS EEPROM/P-Flash on bench to extract PIN/CS bytes (or use OEM online server). 2. Ensure virgin OEM smart key.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Trunk Locks With Smart Key Inside — Trunk LF Antenna Dead!
phContext: Sedans (Vios, City, Altis, Civic); key left in backpack in trunk
symptoms: Trunk latches shut and refuses to pop back open!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check rear trunk bumper/spare-well 125 kHz LF antenna connector (often unplugged during rear bumper/audio work!). 2. Reconnect trunk LF antenna.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Duplicate Cloned Transponder Key Conflicts With Original Key!
phContext: Owner had key cloned (TPX/CN/XT27) and carries BOTH on same keyring
symptoms: Car refuses to start when both keys hang together!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Cloned keys share identical ID and RF collision! Separate keys on different keyrings and test individually.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Smart Key Left Inside Parked Car — Car Won't Lock With Request Button
phContext: Driver left spare smart key in glovebox/bag!
symptoms: Pressing door handle button gives long warning beep, won't lock
diagnosticSteps: 1. Search cabin thoroughly for spare smart key / NFC card! (Interior LF antennas block exterior locking when a key is inside!).

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Ignition Lock Cylinder Wafers Jammed — Key Won't Turn
phContext: High-mileage Honda/Toyota split-wafer ignition locks (Hon66 / TOY43)
symptoms: Key inserts, refuses to rotate from LOCK to ACC
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER spray sticky WD-40 into worn split-wafer locks (gums wafers)! 2. Wiggle key gently while tapping lock face, remove cylinder, and replace worn brass wafers.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Push-Start Car Won't Shut Off Engine While Rolling — Safety Logic
phContext: Driver panicked trying to shut off engine at 5 km/h
symptoms: Quick press of Start button does nothing
diagnosticSteps: 1. To emergency-shutoff push-start engine, press and HOLD Start button for 3+ seconds (or press 3x rapidly)!

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Immobilizer Light Stays Solid (Not Blinking) — ECM/Immo Comm Dead
phContext: Toyota/Mitsubishi/Honda; blown IMMO fuse or broken data wire
symptoms: Security LED stays solid red, cranks no start
diagnosticSteps: 1. Solid security LED usually means Immobilizer antenna/ECU communication failure with ECM! 2. Check IMO/IMI data wires between Immo box and ECM.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Motorcycle Smart Key (Honda PCX/ADV / Yamaha NMAX) Lost Fob
phContext: All-keys-lost scooter; SCU (Smart Control Unit) locked
symptoms: Knob won't turn, owner lost 6-digit emergency tag
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read SCU EEPROM (e.g., 24C04 / 93C66 / PIC MCU) on bench to extract 6-digit ECMID/KeyID! 2. Program new OEM fob directly to SCU.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Water-Damaged Smart Key Fob — Washed in Washing Machine!
phContext: Fob accidentally laundered in jeans pocket
symptoms: LED stays dimly lit, drains new CR2032 in 1 hour, car won't start
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove battery IMMEDIATELY! Ultrasonic-clean fob PCB in 99% isopropyl alcohol and dry thoroughly. 2. Check for shorted ceramic cap; replace fob if MCU corroded.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Remote Works Only When Touched to Chin / Body? (RF Range Weak)
phContext: Aged fob ceramic resonator or weak antenna trace
symptoms: Short 1-meter range
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace CR2032, clean PCB, and test 433 MHz RF power on frequency counter.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Ford / Mazda Key Programming Fails — Only 1 Key Present!
phContext: Owner bought 1 key for All-Keys-Lost PATS job
symptoms: PATS stays in learning mode, refuses to exit with 1 key
diagnosticSteps: 1. Ford/Mazda PATS AKL strictly requires TWO separate transponder chips to close programming cycle! 2. Program 2 keys.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: BCM Replaced With Used Unit — Remote Works, Engine Won't Start!
phContext: Swapped used BCM without matching ECM immobilizer secret
symptoms: Doors lock/unlock remotely, engine cranks & dies
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remote RKE (unlocking) and Immobilizer (starting) are separate pairings in many cars! 2. Transfer EEPROM/Immo data or run full BCM-ECM sync.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Keyless Entry Auto-Unlock When Walking Past Car — Sensitivity
phContext: Drivers whose garage is right beside living room
symptoms: Car unlocks/locks repeatedly draining battery
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disable 'Approach Unlock' in infotainment/BCM settings or keep smart key in RF-shielded Faraday box.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Valet Key Mistaken for Broken Master Key
phContext: Gray-headed Toyota/Honda valet key won't open trunk/glovebox
symptoms: Key starts engine fine, refuses to turn trunk/glovebox lock
diagnosticSteps: 1. Gray valet key has thicker side groove to prevent opening trunk/glovebox! Use black master key.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Isuzu D-Max / mu-X Immobilizer Lockout After Battery Swap
phContext: 2014–2024 Isuzu; weak battery cranking desynced BCM/ECM
symptoms: Security light flashes, no crank
diagnosticSteps: 1. Load-test battery, clear BCM/ECM immo codes, and run Isuzu IDSS Immo Resync / Key Re-learn.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Smart Key Fob Emergency Blade Stuck Inside Shell — Rusted Latch
phContext: Coastal humidity corroding tiny metal slide-release spring in fob
symptoms: Cannot pull emergency key out when battery dies
diagnosticSteps: 1. Apply drop of dry lube to release slider and work gently; clean salt crust.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Chevrolet Trailblazer / Colorado Immobilizer Learn — 12-Min Wait
phContext: GM/Chevrolet PH models; Theft Deterrent Module relearn
symptoms: Padlock light on, no crank
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify battery charger connected (13.5V) and run GM 10/12-minute Immobilizer Learn procedure.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Toyota 4D/G Chip Key Programming — Master vs. Sub Key Limit
phContext: Older Toyota Vios/Innova/Fortuner; max 4–5 keys already stored!
symptoms: Car refuses to add 1 more key!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 'Number of Registered Keys' PID (if 4/4 full, run 'Erase All Keys Except Current' first, then add new key!).

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Push-Start Antenna Ring Around Start Button Damaged by Prongs
phContext: Owner pried Start button bezel with screwdriver
symptoms: NFC backup touch-to-start fails when fob battery is low
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect copper coil antenna wrapped inside Start-Stop switch housing for broken hair-wire. 2. Replace Start-Stop button.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Nissan Smart Key Slot (Older Teana/X-Trail/Altima) Latch Broken
phContext: Older Nissans with dashboard fob-docking slot
symptoms: Car doesn't sense fob inserted in emergency dock
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect microswitch & antenna coil inside dash key-port slot.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: VW / Audi / Skoda Immobilizer 'SAFE' on Cluster — Instrument Cluster
phContext: VAG models in PH; cluster holds Immo3/4/5 data
symptoms: Starts 1 sec and dies, 'SAFE' or 'Immobilizer Active' on cluster
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan Cluster (Address 17) & Immobilizer (Address 25) for key status; check ignition reader coil wires (often corroded green!).

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Subaru Immobilizer / Smart Key Reset — Body Integrated Unit (BIU)
phContext: Subaru Forester/XV/WRX; AKL requires BIU/Smart ECU bench
symptoms: No crank, security light blinking
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read BIU/Smart ECU EEPROM on bench to reset/register new 4D/8A/4A key.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Aftermarket Key Shell Blade Pin Fell Out — Blade Detaches in Lock
phContext: Cheap plastic flip-key shells with loose roll pin
symptoms: Metal blade stays stuck inside ignition while plastic fob twists off!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Extract blade with pliers, use quality OEM-grade shell, and stake roll pin securely.

domainName: Key Programming, Immobilizer EEPROM, Smart Key RF & Theft Lockouts
title: Keyless Go 'Key Left Outside' Warning While Driving — Low Fob
phContext: Smart key battery died mid-drive or passenger got out with key!
symptoms: Cluster chimes 'Key Not In Vehicle' while driving down SLEX!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Note: Engine will NOT shut off while driving, but once turned off it WON'T restart! 2. Check who has the key or touch fob to Start button.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: 200,000+ km Grab/Taxi Vios — Alternator & Starter End-of-Life
phContext: High-cycle city fleets; worn commutator & brushes simultaneously
symptoms: Random slow crank or flickering battery light
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check alternator brush length (<5 mm = replace!) & slip ring wear, plus starter solenoid contacts at 150k– 200k km PM.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Coolant Hoses Swollen ('Buntis') — Burst Risk
phContext: Oil-soaked upper/lower radiator & heater hoses on 150k+ km fleet cars
symptoms: Hose feels mushy/bulging near clamp, bursts in traffic!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Squeeze all coolant hoses cold: mushy, swollen, or crunchy hoses must be replaced proactively before they burst on Skyway!

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Vios / Mirage Rear Shock & Coil Spring Fatigue — 'Tumba'
phContext: Cars carrying 4 passengers + luggage 12 hrs/day
symptoms: Rear tires rub fender liner over bumps, bottoming out
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure rear ride height and inspect shocks/springs; replace fatigued rear coils & bump stops.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Fuel Tank Strainer Clogged — Burns Out 3rd Pump!
phContext: Fleet shop replacing only fuel pump motor without cleaning tank/strainer!
symptoms: New aftermarket pump dies every 4 months!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always replace the in-tank strainer sock & clean tank sediment whenever replacing a fuel pump!

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Driver Seat Bolster & Frame Welds Cracked — Heavy Daily Use
phContext: 200,000+ km taxis/vans; broken seat-back recliner or floor bracket
symptoms: Driver seat rocks backwards on acceleration
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect steel seat-track mounting ears and backrest frame welds for fatigue cracks.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Van / Truck Wheel Bearing Grease Dried Out (Tapered Bearings)
phContext: Older RWD vans/trucks (L300, HiAce, Elf) with serviceable front bearings
symptoms: Humming front wheel, hub scorching hot
diagnosticSteps: 1. Repack front tapered roller bearings with high-temp lithium-complex EP2 grease every 40,000 km and set preload!

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Serpentine Belt Tensioner Weak — Belt Chirps Wet
phContext: 150,000+ km fleet units; fatigued spring inside auto-tensioner
symptoms: Belt slips in rain even with brand-new belt!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check tensioner indicator marks and watch tensioner arm bounce at idle with A/C on; replace tensioner assembly with belt.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: 300,000 km Catalyst Exhausted — Oil Consumption & Sulfur
phContext: Ultra-high-mileage gasoline taxis/TNVS
symptoms: Permanent P0420, high HC/CO
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check compression & oil burn rate before installing new catalyst (burning oil ruins new cat in 6 months!).

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Car Door Hinges Sagging — Latch Strikes High/Hard
phContext: Driver door opened 50+ times daily; worn hinge pins/bushings
symptoms: Must slam driver door hard to close, wind noise
diagnosticSteps: 1. Lift rear edge of open driver door to feel vertical play in lower/upper hinge pins! 2. Replace hinge pins/bushings or hinges.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Ignition Lock Key Worn Smooth — Key Falls Out While Driving!
phContext: 200,000+ km fleet keys worn paper-thin
symptoms: Key slips right out of ignition with engine still running!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Decode original key bitting and cut fresh OEM-thickness blade + replace worn lock tumblers.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Diesel Injector Return Line Hoses Brittle & Cracking
phContext: 150,000+ km CRDi vans; heat-hardened leak-off hoses
symptoms: Diesel smell in cabin, wet engine top
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace all rubber/plastic injector return hoses and O-rings proactively at 120k–150k km.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Transmission Pan Gasket Weep — Bolt Over-Torque
phContext: AT/CVT cars serviced 3–4 times; bent pan flange
symptoms: Slow red ATF drip around pan perimeter
diagnosticSteps: 1. Hammer/straighten dimpled bolt holes on steel pan flange flat before installing new gasket; torque bolts lightly (7–10 N·m).

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Car Cabin Air Recirculation Foam Rotted — Dusty Dash
phContext: Taxis/vans with crumbled HVAC seals
symptoms: Thick dust blowing out vents, weak A/C
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean evaporator box and re-foam blend/recirc doors.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Alternator Bearings Roaring — Sounds Like Water Pump
phContext: 180,000+ km units; dry 6303/6202 alternator bearings
symptoms: Whirring/grinding from front of engine
diagnosticSteps: 1. Use stethoscope on alternator front housing vs. water pump with belt on, then spin by hand with belt off! 2. Replace bearings.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Van Brake Booster Vacuum Hose Hardened Like Plastic
phContext: 10-year-old commercial vans
symptoms: Vacuum leak + hard brake pedal
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace brittle cracked booster hose and check valve.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Grab/TNVS Car Rear Window Regulators Dead From Passenger Abuse
phContext: Passengers forcing child-locked windows or spilling drinks
symptoms: Rear window drops into door
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check window lock switch first, then inspect regulator cable/motor.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Catalytic Converter Heat Shield Rusted Loose
phContext: Taxis/commuters; loud rattle at 1500 RPM
symptoms: Tinny buzz under floor
diagnosticSteps: 1. Secure loose heat shield with large stainless steel worm-drive band clamps!

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Pickup Bed-Liner Trapping Wet Silt — Rusted Truck Bed
phContext: Work pickups (Hilux, Strada, Navara, D-Max)
symptoms: Hidden rust perforation under drop-in plastic bed liner
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull plastic bed liner annually to wash out trapped dirt/leaves and inspect bed floor.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Power Steering Fluid Never Changed — Pump Wear
phContext: 150k+ km hydraulic-PS vans
symptoms: Heavy steering when parking hot
diagnosticSteps: 1. Flush black burnt PS fluid completely and clean reservoir mesh.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Car Headlight Lenses Yellowed/Oxidized — Poor Night Vision
phContext: Outdoor-parked cars in intense PH UV sun
symptoms: Dim headlights despite new bulbs
diagnosticSteps: 1. Wet-sand oxidized UV clearcoat (800->1500->3000 grit), polish, and seal with UV 2K clearcoat or PPF!

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Fuel Tank Straps Rusted Thin — Tank Sagging
phContext: 10+ year old coastal fleet vehicles
symptoms: Clunking fuel tank over bumps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect steel fuel tank support straps for heavy rust flaking and replace before strap snaps!

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Car Battery Clamp Corrosion Eating Positive Harness
phContext: Neglected battery maintenance
symptoms: Green sulfate creeping 15 cm up main red cable
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace corroded terminal & cable section; apply felt anti-corrosion washers + terminal grease.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Manual Gearshift Bushings Crumbled — Sloppy Stick
phContext: Older Vios, L300, Hilux; 3 inches of play in gear
symptoms: Hard to find 1st vs. 3rd gear
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace worn nylon shifter base & linkage bushings under console/transmission.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Van Rear Leaf Spring Bushings Metal-on-Metal
phContext: Overloaded vans; worn rubber shackle eyes
symptoms: Clanking over every bump
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace leaf spring eye & shackle bushings before steel pin wears through spring eye!

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Spark Plugs Seized in Aluminum Head — Snap Risk
phContext: Plugs left in 100,000+ km without anti-seize/change
symptoms: Plug creaks loudly when loosening
diagnosticSteps: 1. Crack plug 1/8 turn, spray penetrating oil, work back-and-forth gently on warm (not scorching hot!) engine to avoid stripping head threads.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Car A/C Condenser Fins Bent Flat by Pressure Washer
phContext: Car wash spraying high-pressure nozzle 5 cm from grille!
symptoms: A/C warm in traffic, engine runs hot
diagnosticSteps: 1. Never blast radiator/condenser fins close-up with pressure washer! 2. Straighten bent fins carefully with fin comb.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Clutch Master Cylinder Reservoir Black Sludge
phContext: Neglected hydraulic clutch fluid
symptoms: Dark fluid, sticky pedal
diagnosticSteps: 1. Flush clutch fluid every 40,000 km with fresh DOT4.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Car Spare Tire Flat When Needed — Valve Stem Rotted
phContext: Spare tire ignored for 5 years under trunk/chassis
symptoms: Flat spare during roadside blowout
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check spare tire pressure (45–60 psi donut, 35 psi full-size) and rubber valve stem crack at every PMS!

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Engine Oil Pan Plug Stripped — Teflon Tape Leak
phContext: Cars serviced at quick-lube shops with air-impacted drain plugs
symptoms: Slow oil drip from drain plug
diagnosticSteps: 1. Never use Teflon tape on oil drain plugs! 2. Use oversized self-tapping repair plug or Time-Sert / replace oil pan.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Van Rear Tailgate Struts / Hinges Binding — Rust
phContext: Delivery vans opened 30x/day in rain
symptoms: Gate squeaks, tears hinge sheetmetal
diagnosticSteps: 1. Lubricate rear door hinges/check straps and replace weak gas struts.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Exhaust Flex Pipe Frayed — Carbon Monoxide Hazard!
phContext: Low sedans/vans hitting speed bumps
symptoms: Exhaust noise + fumes inside cabin at stoplights
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect front exhaust flex braid for leaks (CO gas enters cabin HVAC intake!). 2. Weld new flex pipe immediately.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Car Wiper Arm Splines Stripped — Wiper Stops in Storm
phContext: Wiper arms bolted loosely after windshield work
symptoms: Motor runs, wiper arm flops dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean aluminum wiper arm splines & steel post splines, seat firmly, and torque 12–14mm nut tightly.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Brake Caliper Bleeder Clogged — Fluid Never Changed
phContext: 10-year-old fluid turning to brown mud
symptoms: Boiling brakes, rusted calipers
diagnosticSteps: 1. Flush brake fluid every 2 years / 40,000 km!
