domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Car Trunk / Hood Weatherstrip Torn — Water Leak
phContext: Aged rubber seals flattening/cracking
symptoms: Wet spare tire well or wet engine bay fuse box
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect perimeter rubber weatherstripping and clear trunk/cowl rain channels.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Starter Motor Drive Gear Dry — Slow Return Buzz
phContext: 200k+ km starters; dry helical splines on armature
symptoms: Brief 1-second rattle right after engine fires
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disassemble starter, clean dry clutch dust off bendix splines, lubricate lightly with dry/thin grease.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Car Fuel Cap Tether Snapped / Missing — Lost Cap
phContext: Drivers leaving cap on gas pump
symptoms: EVAP P0455/P0456 MIL
diagnosticSteps: 1. Install OEM tethered gas cap.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Radiator Overflow Hose Cracked — Coolant Loss Hot
phContext: Small rubber siphon hose between radiator neck and overflow bottle
symptoms: Coolant boils out instead of sucking back in when cooling!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect siphon hose inside overflow bottle too (if cracked/missing, radiator sucks air instead of coolant when cooling down!).

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Van Cab Floor Rust Under Vinyl Mat — Wet Boots
phContext: Delivery vans (L300, Traviz, Elf) with trapped moisture under rubber mat
symptoms: Rusted floorpan holes letting dust/fumes in
diagnosticSteps: 1. Lift vinyl floor mat periodically to dry trapped rain/sweat and treat surface rust.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage O2 Sensor Seized in Exhaust — Thread Galling
phContext: 150k+ km sensors baked by exhaust heat
symptoms: Risk of stripping exhaust bung threads
diagnosticSteps: 1. Spray penetrating oil on warm bung, use 6-point O2 socket, work back-and-forth, and apply nickel anti-seize ONLY on new sensor threads (never on tip!).

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Vehicle Tire Rotation Skipped — Fronts Bald, Rears 80%
phContext: FWD cars never rotated
symptoms: Poor wet braking/hydroplanin g
diagnosticSteps: 1. Rotate tires every 10,000 km (always mount best 2 tires on REAR axle if buying only 2 new tires to prevent wet-road oversteer spinout!).

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Timing Belt Sticker Missing — Unknown Service History
phContext: Used fleet cars with blank timing cover
symptoms: Risk of sudden belt snap!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull upper timing cover to inspect belt ribs/cracks; if unknown history >80,000 km, replace belt + water pump proactively.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Car Aircon Filter Missing Completely! — Evaporator Caked
phContext: Shop threw away dirty cabin filter without installing new one!
symptoms: Evaporator core clogged solid with black lint/mud, weak airflow
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always verify cabin air filter is actually present in slot! 2. Clean caked evaporator coil and install new filter.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: High-Mileage Valve Cover Bolts Loose — Oil Seeping Onto Exhaust
phContext: 5+ year old engines; flattened rubber gasket
symptoms: Burning oil smoke from hood after traffic crawl
diagnosticSteps: 1. Never just crank down bolts on hardened gasket (cracks plastic valve cover!). 2. Replace rubber valve cover gasket & grommets.

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Car Seatbelt Retractor Slow to Retract — Greasy Webbing
phContext: Dirty/sweaty seatbelts jammed in door jamb
symptoms: Belt hangs slack, gets slammed in door
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull belt all the way out, wash webbing with mild dish soap & warm water, dry completely (retract speed doubles!).

domainName: Commercial Fleet, Delivery Van & Grab/TNVS High-Mileage Preventive Faults
title: Fleet Preventive Telematics Check — Early Battery/Alternator Alert
phContext: Connected fleet cars logging voltage drops
symptoms: Pre-failure 12.1V crank alerts before driver gets stranded
diagnosticSteps: 1. Flag any fleet unit logging cranking voltage <9.8V or charging <13.4V for immediate shop battery/alternator PM.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: High-Altitude (Baguio / Atok 1,500–2,200m) Rich Running — Skewed Baro
phContext: Older EFI/diesel cars climbing Cordillera; dirty MAF or stuck Baro
symptoms: Black smoke, sluggish climb at 2,000m elevation, clears in lowlands
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read Baro PID (sea level ~101 kPa; Baguio ~85 kPa; Atok ~78 kPa!). 2. Clean MAF/MAP sensor so ECU calculates reduced air density accurately.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Cordillera Steep Climb Overheating — Low Coolant / Weak Fan Clutch
phContext: Vans/SUVs climbing Kennon / Marcos / Halsema loaded with passengers
symptoms: Temp gauge hits red 3/4 up mountain, boils over
diagnosticSteps: 1. Turn A/C OFF immediately on steep 1st/2nd gear climbs if temp rises past 2/3! 2. Inspect viscous fan clutch, radiator cap (1.1 bar), and mud-free fins before mountain trips.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Downhill Brake Fade / Boiled Fluid Descending Mountain Switchbacks
phContext: Automatic/CVT cars descending Baguio/Tagaytay riding foot brake
symptoms: Pedal goes soft/floor, acrid burning pad smell, smoking wheels
diagnosticSteps: 1. Shift to L / 2 / M1-M2 / B-mode for engine braking! 2. Flush old moisture-laden DOT3 with fresh high-boiling-point DOT4.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Coastal Salt-Air Galvanic Corrosion on Aluminum Alternator/AC Fittings
phContext: Vehicles parked near ocean (Batangas, Cavite, Visayas, Mindanao coasts)
symptoms: White powdery salt crust eating aluminum A/C pipes & alternator case
diagnosticSteps: 1. Wash engine bay & underbody with fresh water + Salt-Away/mild soap after coastal storms; inspect A/C condenser bottom tubes for salt pitting.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Coastal Frame Rail & Crossmember Rust Perforation
phContext: 10+ year old pickups/SUVs parked on damp coastal soil/sand
symptoms: Flaking structural rust on rear frame arch & spare tire crossmember
diagnosticSteps: 1. Tap suspect frame rails with ball-peen hammer (dull thud = rotted inside!). 2. Flush internal frame rail mud & apply lanolin/wax cavity rustproofing.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: River-Crossing Thermal Shock — Cracked Hot Diff / Exhaust / Alternator
phContext: 4x4s plunging hot drivetrain straight into cold mountain river!
symptoms: Diff oil turns milky (sucks water as hot axle cools!), alternator dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Let axles/exhaust cool 5–10 min before fording deep rivers, and install extended diff/transfer-case breather tubes up to firewall!

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Mud-Packed Rear Drum Brakes — Zero Braking & Rapid Shoe Wear
phContext: Provincial pickups/4x4s driving through deep clay mud
symptoms: Grinding noise, rear shoes worn to metal in 1,000 km!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull rear drums immediately after muddy trail/flood runs to hose out abrasive clay grit trapped inside backing plates!

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Mud-Caked Radiator & A/C Condenser — Delayed Overheat Next Day
phContext: Off-roaders/trucks; wet mud dries into concrete brick inside fins!
symptoms: Runs fine on trail, overheats next day on expressway!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Shine bright light through radiator core from behind; flush dried clay gently with garden hose from engine side forward.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Cordillera Cold Morning Hard Start (8–12°C) — Weak Battery / Glows
phContext: Diesel pickups/vans parked overnight in Baguio/Sagada
symptoms: Long cranking + white smoke puff at 6 AM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test all 4 glow plugs (cold weather exposes 1–2 dead glow plugs immediately!). 2. Check battery CCA and switch from 20W-50 to 5W-30/10W-30 oil.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Dusty Provincial Gravel Roads — Clogged Air Filter in 3,000 km
phContext: Pickups/vans on lahar/unpaved quarry/farm roads
symptoms: Black smoke, sluggish pull, high fuel use
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect/tap clean paper air filter every 2,000 km in dusty provinces (never blow high-pressure air from outside-in — blows dust through pores!).

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Rats / Mice Nesting Under Intake Manifold — Provincial Outdoor Park
phContext: Cars parked near rice fields/farms overnight
symptoms: Chewed knock/injector/MAF wires, rice husks under engine cover
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect engine bay under plastic cover for droppings/chewed looms! 2. Wrap repaired wires in bitter/capsaicin anti-rodent tape.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Ants / Cockroaches Shorting Cabin BCM / Door Modules!
phContext: Cars parked under mango/acacia trees or with food crumbs inside
symptoms: Crazy interior lights, dead central lock, ant nest inside BCM!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove kick-panel BCM/fuse box and inspect PCB for ant/roach nests shorting SMD traces! 2. Clean PCB with IPA and seal cabin entry points.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Tree Sap & Bird Droppings Etching Clearcoat & Clogging Cowl Drains
phContext: Cars parked under shade trees in provinces
symptoms: Water sloshing in cowl, leaking onto cabin blower/ECM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clear leaves/twigs from windshield cowl grilles & sunroof drains monthly.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: 4x4 Transfer Case Skid Plate Packed With Dried Mud — Overheating
phContext: Off-road pickups; 20 kg of mud insulating transmission/exhaust
symptoms: High trans temp warning, burning mud smell
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drop skid plates after off-road trips and wash packed mud off transmission pan, exhaust, and front diff.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Stones Wedged Between Brake Rotor & Dust Shield — Horrible Screech
phContext: Gravel-road commuters
symptoms: Ear-piercing metal-on-metal shriek when rolling
diagnosticSteps: 1. Flex thin steel dust shield slightly away from rotor with screwdriver to let trapped pebble drop out!

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Tire Sidewall Cut by Sharp Limestone / Bamboo — Slow Leak
phContext: Provincial/farm roads
symptoms: Tire flat overnight with intact tread
diagnosticSteps: 1. Spray soapy water on inner & outer tire sidewalls; NEVER patch a sidewall puncture (replace tire!).

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Coastal Battery Terminal Rapid Sulfation — Loose Felt & Salt
phContext: Coastal towns; thick green/white bloom growing weekly
symptoms: No-crank, corroded positive clamp
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean with baking soda + water, install anti-corrosion felt washers, and seal with dielectric grease.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: High-Altitude Turbo Lag (Baguio/Atok) — Thinner Air Density
phContext: Non-VGT / older turbo diesels at 2,000m+
symptoms: Slow spool from standstill on steep uphill
diagnosticSteps: 1. Normal physics at 20% thinner air; verify zero boost leaks or clogged air filter so turbo compensates efficiently.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: CVT Overheat Climbing Kennon Road Behind Slow Trucks
phContext: CVT crossovers/sedans crawling 15 km/h uphill in 35°C heat
symptoms: CVT warning light, reduced power
diagnosticSteps: 1. Shift CVT to 'L' / 'S' / manual low ratio on long climbs to keep pulley clamping pressure high and fluid cooler! 2. Let cool 15 min if light triggers.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Diesel Fuel Waxing? (Rare) vs. Water Freezing in Sagada Winter
phContext: 8°C morning in Sagada/Atok with high-water diesel
symptoms: Hard start, sputtering
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drain water separator bowl! (Philippine tropical diesel doesn't wax at 10°C, but water droplets in clogged filter choke flow).

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Provincial Voltage Sag (185V AC) Tripping Home EV Charger
phContext: EV owners charging at provincial ancestral home
symptoms: Portable EVSE flashes fault or drops to 1 kW
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure wall outlet AC voltage under load (<195V trips EVSE undervoltage protection!). 2. Lower EVSE amps to 8A or use dedicated thick line.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Flooded / Muddy Starter Bendix Sticking — Won't Retract
phContext: Pickups after muddy trail crossing
symptoms: Grinding noise after engine starts
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove starter, wash mud out of pinion gear & solenoid plunger, and lubricate lightly.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Rusted Exhaust Flange Bolts Snapping During O2 / Cat Service
phContext: Coastal/older cars
symptoms: Exhaust leak after hitting speed bump
diagnosticSteps: 1. Soak rusted exhaust nuts in penetrating oil overnight; apply induction heater before turning.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Provincial Fuel Station Contaminated Diesel — Instant Filter Clog
phContext: Trucks/pickups fueled at remote rural station after heavy rain
symptoms: Water-in-Fuel light + P0087 5 km after refueling!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Immediately drain water separator into clear jar to confirm water/rust contamination! 2. Drain tank and replace filter.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Mud-Jammed Cooling Fan Blade — Burns Out Fan Motor / Blows Fuse
phContext: 4x4s/cars after deep muddy puddle
symptoms: Fan doesn't spin, 40A fuse blown, engine overheats!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check fan blade clearance inside shroud for dried mud/sticks BEFORE replacing blown fan fuse!

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Seized Caliper Slide Pins From Brackish Coastal Floodwater
phContext: Malabon/Navotas/Bacoor/Cavite tidal flood areas
symptoms: Dragging brakes, uneven pad wear
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disassemble, clean rust, replace torn rubber boots, and pack with waterproof silicone grease.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Leaf Spring U-Bolt & Center Pin Rust-Seized — Squeaks Loudly
phContext: Coastal pickups/vans
symptoms: Loud groan over bumps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Spray dry PTFE/silicone between leaf tips (avoid attracting grit with sticky grease).

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Snorkel Pre-Cleaner / Intake Clogged With Insects / Leaves
phContext: 4x4s with aftermarket snorkel driving provincial highways at night
symptoms: Black smoke, P0101, sluggish power
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove snorkel ram-head grille and clean packed moths/leaves!

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Worn Shock Absorbers Boiling Oil on Rough Dirt Roads ('Corrugations')
phContext: Pickups/SUVs driving fast on washboard gravel roads
symptoms: Shocks get scorching hot, car bounces uncontrollably
diagnosticSteps: 1. Upgrade to monotube gas shocks for sustained rough-road heat dissipation.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: 4x4 Winch Solenoid Corroded — Fails When Needed in Mud!
phContext: Off-road pickups with front bumper winch
symptoms: Winch clicks, won't spool in/out
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test winch monthly! Inspect sealed contactor box behind grille for water corrosion & loose battery terminals.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Rear Taillight Sockets Rusted Out — Coastal Humidity
phContext: Older pickups/vans; bulb contacts turned to green powder
symptoms: Brake/signal lights fail intermittently
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean/replace corroded bulb sockets and coat bulb bases lightly with dielectric grease.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Mountain Descent Alternator Overcharge? No — High RPM Engine Brake
phContext: Drivers holding 4,500 RPM down mountain in 2nd gear
symptoms: Battery light? Only if belt slips at high RPM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify alternator belt tension & OAP clutch pulley.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Mud-Filled Spare Tire Winch — Can't Lower Spare on Roadside
phContext: Pickups/MPVs
symptoms: Winch key spins or locks solid
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drop, wash, and grease spare tire winch cable every 6 months.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Provincial Power Outage — V2L Used Overnight Draining EV
phContext: EV owner using BYD/MG V2L for house fans/fridge during typhoon brownout
symptoms: EV down to 10% SOC
diagnosticSteps: 1. Monitor EV SOC via app/dash; set V2L discharge limit to 20% so car can still drive to charger!

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Salt-Corroded ABS Tone Ring Swelling ('Jacking') Under Sensor
phContext: Coastal sedans/pickups; rust lifting magnetic encoder
symptoms: False ABS activation at low speed
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull ABS sensor and inspect magnetic hub seal/tone ring for rust flaking; replace hub bearing.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Rusted Hood Latch Cable Snapping — Can't Open Hood!
phContext: Coastal/older cars; dry steel hood cable inside sheath
symptoms: Pulling hood release lever inside cabin feels slack, hood stays locked
diagnosticSteps: 1. Reach up from under bumper/grille to trip latch lever manually; replace & grease hood cable and latch spring!

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Fuel Tank Skid Plate Full of Wet Dirt — Rotting Tank Bottom
phContext: Off-road SUVs/pickups
symptoms: Rusty fuel tank bottom
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drop fuel tank skid plate periodically to flush out trapped mud/stones.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: 4x4 Rear Diff Lock Actuator Breather Tube Cracked — Water Entry
phContext: Toyota/Ford/Mitsubishi rear e-locker
symptoms: Diff lock stuck/corroded
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect small rubber breather hose on rear diff actuator motor for dry-rot cracks.

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Cordillera Foggy Rain — A/C Defrost Fails Without Compressor!
phContext: Drivers turning A/C button OFF in cold Baguio rain to 'save gas'
symptoms: Windshield fogs up solid inside within 1 minute!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Keep A/C compressor ON even with warm temp dial when defrosting windshield! (A/C dehumidifies cabin air!).

domainName: Coastal Salt-Air, Mountain Highland (Baguio/Sagada) & Provincial Off-Road Faults
title: Underbody Acoustic / Heat Shield Sagging After Flood Crossing
phContext: Sedans/crossovers; floodwater tearing fiber/aluminum under-trays
symptoms: Loud scraping noise dragging on asphalt
diagnosticSteps: 1. Re-secure sagging plastic/aluminum underbody splash shields with proper push-clips/bolts.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: EV/HEV Service Plug Pulled Without 10-Min Discharge Wait!
phContext: Technician touching orange inverter cables immediately after pulling plug
symptoms: Lethal 300V–800V DC shock hazard from inverter bus capacitors!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Wear Class 0 (1000V) insulated gloves (air-tested for pinholes!). 2. Pull orange HV service plug, wait 10+ minutes, and VERIFY <10V DC across inverter terminals with CAT III/IV 1000V meter BEFORE touching!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Class 0 (1000V) Insulated Gloves Torn / Expired — Shock Risk
phContext: Workshop sharing old cracked rubber HV gloves
symptoms: Pinholes invisible to naked eye
diagnosticSteps: 1. Roll-and-trap air test BOTH rubber HV gloves before EVERY single HV job (any air leak = discard!). 2. Wear leather outer protectors over rubber gloves.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Probing Yellow SRS Airbag Squib With Ohmmeter — Deployment Risk!
phContext: Technician checking airbag squib resistance with standard DMM
symptoms: DMM ohm-mode current can fire airbag squib in technician's face!
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER probe live airbag/pretensioner squibs with an ohmmeter or test light! 2. Disconnect 12V battery (-), wait 10 min for SRS backup capacitor discharge, and use 2.2 Ω simulator.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: J2534 ECU Flashing Without Stabilized Power Supply — Bricked ECU!
phContext: Technician flashing ECM/TCM using bare car battery alone
symptoms: Cooling fans kick on mid-flash, voltage drops <11.5V, ECU bricks!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always connect a clean, ripple-free 13.5V–14.2V 30A+ programming power supply (NOT a noisy trickle/boost charger!) during ECU flashing!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: OBD Memory Saver Backfeeding 12V While Working on Alternator/Starter!
phContext: Tech plugged 12V memory saver into OBD port, then unbolted starter B+
symptoms: Starter B+ cable sparks violently against block, blowing OBD/ECM fuse!
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER leave an OBD memory saver plugged in while disconnecting starter, alternator, or airbag harnesses!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Testing GDI/Piezo Injector With 12V Jumper — Instant Coil Melt
phContext: Tech applying raw 12V battery jumper to 1.5-ohm GDI/piezo injector
symptoms: Smoke in 2 seconds, ruined P15,000+ injector!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check OEM coil resistance first! Low-impedance (<3 Ω) GDI/CRDi and piezo (100–200V) injectors MUST only be driven by current-limited/proper bench drivers!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Multimeter Leads Left in '10A' Jack While Measuring Battery Voltage!
phContext: Rushed technician probing 12V/24V battery with red lead in 10A port
symptoms: Massive arc flash, blown meter fuse, burned probe tip!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always verify red lead is in 'V/Ω' jack before touching voltage! 2. Use CAT III 600V+ meter with genuine HRC ceramic fuses.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Airbag Module Unbolted With Battery Connected — Tilt Triggers Bags!
phContext: Technician unbolting SRS ECU on floor tunnel with key ON
symptoms: Rotating live SRS ECU can trigger rollover/side curtain deployment!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always disconnect 12V negative & wait 10 min before unbolting or plugging/unplugging ANY SRS ECU or crash sensor!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Static Discharge (ESD) Frying Exposed ECU PCB on Bench
phContext: Tech handling bare ECU motherboard on plastic mat without grounding
symptoms: MCU or EEPROM dies mysteriously after bench inspection
diagnosticSteps: 1. Use ESD wrist strap & grounded ESD mat when handling open ECU PCBs, Flash chips, and MOSFETs!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Using Standard R134a Manifold Gauges on EV/HEV HV Compressor!
phContext: A/C shop using PAG-oil-contaminated hoses on hybrid/EV A/C
symptoms: Conductive PAG oil contaminates POE system -> P0AA6 isolation fault!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Use dedicated POE-only manifold hoses & recovery machine (or flush hoses thoroughly) for ALL Hybrid/EV electric compressors!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Opening Hot Radiator Cap — Severe Scalding Steam Burn
phContext: Driver/tech opening radiator cap on overheated engine
symptoms: Boiling 110°C coolant erupts violently
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER open radiator/degas cap hot! Wait until upper hose is cool and squeeze-soft, or cover with thick wet rag and turn slowly to 1st detent.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Diesel High-Pressure Common Rail Fuel Leak — Injection Skin Injury
phContext: Technician checking 1,600 bar (23,000 psi!) CRDi line leak with bare hand
symptoms: Pinpoint high-pressure diesel jet pierces skin → fatal necrosis!
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER feel high-pressure common rail lines with fingers while cranking/running! Use cardboard strip to check for mist leaks and wear safety glasses.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Working Under Car Supported Only by Scissor/Hydraulic Jack!
phContext: Deadly roadside/shop shortcut without jack stands
symptoms: Hydraulic jack seal fails, car drops instantly
diagnosticSteps: 1. ALWAYS place rated jack stands under frame/pinch welds + wheel chocks before going under ANY vehicle!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Lead-Acid Battery Explosion — Spark Near Charging Vent Caps
phContext: Disconnecting jumper clamp directly at battery (+) while charging
symptoms: Hydrogen gas inside battery ignites, exploding acid everywhere!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Connect/disconnect final negative jumper clamp onto bare engine/chassis ground AWAY from battery, and wear eye protection!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Laptop / Oscilloscope Grounding Through Mains AC Earth to Car
phContext: Plugged-in AC-powered bench scope probing floating 12V/24V circuit
symptoms: Ground loop shorts laptop USB port or blows scope input!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Run diagnostic laptop on battery (unplugged from AC) or use USB galvanic isolator when probing vehicle circuits!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: EV Smart Key Left in Pocket Near Car During HV Service!
phContext: Technician carries smart key while working on HV inverter
symptoms: Assistant or bump presses Start → car enters READY while hands inside!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove smart key 10+ meters away, hang 'DO NOT OPERATE — HV SERVICE' tag on steering wheel, and disconnect 12V negative!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Brake Cleaner Used Near Hot Exhaust / Welding — Phosgene Gas / Fire!
phContext: Spraying flammable brake cleaner on hot manifold or before welding
symptoms: Instant flash fire or toxic phosgene fumes (if chlorinated)!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Use non-chlorinated cleaner only on COLD parts; never weld near brake cleaner residue!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Power Probe / 12V Injector Piercing Waterproof Wire Insulation
phContext: Tech poking sharp probe through sealed engine-bay wire jacket
symptoms: Green corrosion eats wire completely in half 6 months later!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Backprobe from rear of connector! If wire piercing is unavoidable, seal tiny pinhole immediately with liquid electrical tape / adhesive heat-shrink!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Two-Post Lift Arm Pad Placed Under EV Battery Pack!
phContext: Lifting BYD/MG/Tesla on battery pack edge instead of pinch-weld lift pads
symptoms: Crushed HV battery cooling plate or frame!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always use OEM rubber lift pucks at marked chassis jack points — NEVER lift against underbody HV battery pack!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Cheap ELM327 / Clone VCI Hanging CAN Bus While Driving
phContext: Leaving low-quality Bluetooth OBD dongle plugged in permanently
symptoms: Random dash glitches, drained battery
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove diagnostic VCI when finished unless using verified low-power sleep-mode adapter.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Clutch / Brake Dust Blown With Compressed Air — Asbestos/Silica Hazard
phContext: Shop blowing brake drum dust clouds with air gun
symptoms: Toxic dust inhaled by entire shop
diagnosticSteps: 1. Wash brake/clutch dust wet with brake cleaner/water vacuum — never blow dry dust clouds!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Jumper Cables Reversed on Dual-Battery 24V Truck!
phContext: Connecting 12V jump pack across 24V series pair, or reversing +/-
symptoms: Exploding battery or fried 24V ECM/alternator!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify 12V vs. 24V system FIRST! On 24V trucks, use 24V jump source across outer (+) and (-) terminals, or charge each 12V battery separately.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Bench PSU Current Limit Left at Max (10A) on Shorted ECU
phContext: Powering water-damaged ECU without current limit
symptoms: Burns PCB copper trace off board before you spot short!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Set bench power supply current limit to 0.5A–1.0A first when powering unknown/damaged ECUs!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Solder Fumes & Lead Contamination in Closed Aircon Bench Room
phContext: Reworking ECUs in small sealed room without extractor
symptoms: Headaches, respiratory irritation
diagnosticSteps: 1. Use HEPA/carbon solder fume extractor fan and wash hands after handling leaded solder.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Incorrect Torque on Aluminum Cylinder Head / Oil Pan Drain Bolt
phContext: Using 1/2-inch ratchet on M6/M8 aluminum threads
symptoms: Stripped aluminum threads
diagnosticSteps: 1. Use 1/4-inch or 3/8-inch calibrated torque wrench for small aluminum-housing fasteners.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Gasoline Fuel Tank Welding / Grinding Without Purging!
phContext: Welding strap or exhaust near fuel tank/vapor
symptoms: Catastrophic tank explosion!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Never weld/grind near fuel tanks or lines; remove tank and purge completely if tank repair needed.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Hybrid/EV Cooling Fan Turns On Unexpectedly Key-Off
phContext: Electric fans controlled by thermal timer even with key in pocket
symptoms: Fingers caught in fan blades
diagnosticSteps: 1. Keep hands clear of electric fans whenever 12V battery is connected!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Diagnostic Tablet Battery Swollen in Hot Shop
phContext: Diagnostic scanner tablet left on dashboard in 50°C sun
symptoms: Screen lifting, lithium fire hazard
diagnosticSteps: 1. Store diagnostic tablets in shaded case; replace swollen batteries immediately.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Using Wrong Polarity on Bench Capacitor / Diode Replacement
phContext: Replacing electrolytic cap or TVS diode backwards on ECU PCB
symptoms: Cap explodes with pop when powered up!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Double-check cathode stripe / (+) pad polarity on PCB silkscreen before soldering!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Pulling Spark Plug Wire While Running — 30kV Shock & Fried Coil!
phContext: Old-school 'cylinder drop test' by pulling live coil/plug wire
symptoms: Painful 30,000V shock & secondary arc fries modern ECM coil driver!
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER pull live ignition coils/wires to test misfire on modern cars! Use scan tool injector cut-out or unplug injector connector instead.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Timing Belt Tensioner Pin Pulled Before Checking Marks
phContext: Timing belt service; hydraulic tensioner grenade pin
symptoms: Pin pulled prematurely before belt alignment
diagnosticSteps: 1. Must re-compress hydraulic tensioner slowly in vise (fast press ruins hydraulic damper!) and re-pin before mounting.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Tire Bead Seating Explosion — Excessive Air Pressure / Ether
phContext: Vulcanizing shop seating stiff tire bead >50 psi
symptoms: Bead wire snaps explosively
diagnosticSteps: 1. Never exceed 40 psi when seating tire beads; lubricate bead generously and use tire cage.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Coil Spring Compressor Slipping — Deadly Stored Energy
phContext: Removing McPherson strut top nut without spring compressor!
symptoms: Top mount shoots across shop like a missile!
diagnosticSteps: 1. ALWAYS clamp coil spring symmetrically with dual safety-hook compressors before loosening center strut nut!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: EV Battery Fire / Thermal Runaway Signs After Flood/Crash
phContext: Hissing, sweet chemical smell, popping cells, or rising temp on HV pack
symptoms: Toxic HF gas & unstoppable fire
diagnosticSteps: 1. Evacuate area, isolate vehicle outdoors >15m from buildings, call BFP/fire dept (requires massive water cooling, not small dry-chem!).

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: O2 Sensor / Exhaust Burn — Touching Downpipe After Test Drive
phContext: Hot catalytic converter at 450°C+
symptoms: Instant severe burn
diagnosticSteps: 1. Let exhaust cool or wear Kevlar/leather welding sleeves.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Wrong OBD-II Pinout Adapter on Pre-1996 / Proprietary Port
phContext: Forcing 16-pin adapter onto Toyota 22-pin / Mitsubishi 12-pin / Hino
symptoms: Shorts 12V to signal pin
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify OEM DLC pinout diagram before jumpering or using proprietary adapters.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Air Conditioning UV Dye Allergy / Eye Splash
phContext: Disconnecting pressurized A/C hose without safety goggles
symptoms: Refrigerant frostbite & oil splash in eyes
diagnosticSteps: 1. Recover refrigerant fully to 0 psi before opening any A/C fitting; wear goggles.

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Bench Scope Probe Set to 1x Instead of 10x on Injector Spike!
phContext: Probing 80V–150V inductive injector spike with 1x probe (max 30V– 50V!)
symptoms: Clips waveform or damages scope front-end!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Set scope probe & software channel to 10x (or use 20:1 attenuator) whenever probing ignition primary or injector spikes!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: ECU Firmware Mismatch — Flashing Wrong Market (RHD/USDM vs. PHDM)
phContext: Flashing downloaded internet bin file onto customer's PH vehicle!
symptoms: Lost immobilizer, wrong emissions, bricked ECU!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always verify exact Calibration ID / Hardware PN match for Philippine market (PHDM/ASEAN) and keep full backup!

domainName: Workshop Safety, HV PPE, ESD Protection & Diagnostic Tool Edge Cases
title: Workshop Surge Protector Missing on Bench PSU / Programmer
phContext: PH brownouts & voltage spikes during EEPROM/ECU programming
symptoms: PC/PSU reboots mid-write bricking ECU!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Plug bench ECU programmer & laptop into pure-sine-wave UPS + AVR!

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Misfire + Lean Trim + Whistling Sound — Torn Valve Cover PCV
phContext: Turbo/GDI crossovers (MG, Geely, Ford, Hyundai)
symptoms: Rough idle, loud whistle, oil cap sucked down hard
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull oil cap/dipstick at idle: whistle vanishes & idle changes = torn PCV diaphragm in valve cover (NOT bad coils or MAF!). 2. Replace valve cover.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Christmas-Tree Dash + Limp Mode — Failing Alternator Diode Ripple
phContext: Toyota/Mitsubishi/Honda; 14.0V DC looks okay, 1.2V AC ripple!
symptoms: ABS + EPS + AT + MIL flicker together in traffic
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure AC Volts across battery at 2000 RPM (>0.1V AC = bad alternator rectifier!). 2. Fix alternator first — all cascading U-codes clear!

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Clogged Catalytic Converter Mimicking Bad MAF, O2 & Fuel Pump
phContext: High-mileage Vios/City/Innova; chokes above 3000 RPM
symptoms: Starts fine, zero power uphill, glowing red exhaust
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove B1S1 O2 sensor temporarily to relieve backpressure: if engine suddenly revs freely, cat is plugged! 2. Fix misfire cause & replace cat.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Diesel Triple-Fault — Split Intercooler Hose Over-Sooting DPF!
phContext: Euro-4 Hilux/Fortuner/Ranger/Mo ntero; ignored boost leak
symptoms: Black smoke -> DPF clogs -> P0087/limp mode!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pressure-test charge pipes FIRST (split hose causes heavy soot that plugs EGR & DPF!). 2. Fix boost hose, clean EGR, then regen DPF!

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Dead ECM + No Crank + Blank Scanner — Corroded Engine Ground!
phContext: Cars after transmission/engine work; forgotten G101 ground
symptoms: Key turns ON, zero MIL, no crank, scanner 'No Link'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Before condemning ECM, test ECM ground pins & engine block ground strap with loaded test light to B+! 2. Clean/bolt ground strap.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: 5V Reference Collapse — One Shorted A/C Pressure Sensor!
phContext: Any modern car; shorted 3-pin A/C sensor kills MAP, APP, FRP!
symptoms: Engine won't rev, 5 different sensor codes at once!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure 5V VREF (reads <2V). 2. Unplug A/C pressure sensor near condenser (often hit/wet!): 5V snaps back to 5.00V! 3. Replace A/C sensor.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Engine Overheating Cascading Into A/C Cutout & TCM Shift Protect
phContext: Sedans/SUVs in EDSA traffic; dead radiator fan
symptoms: A/C goes warm, then transmission shifts harshly, then temp gauge hits red!
diagnosticSteps: 1. ECM cuts A/C at 108°C and locks transmission shift strategy to cool engine! 2. Fix dead radiator fan motor/relay to solve all 3 symptoms.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Hydro-Lock From Leaky Fuel Injector Overnight (Not Flood!)
phContext: Gasoline car won't crank in morning, smells strongly of gas
symptoms: Starter clunks once against liquid-locked cylinder!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull spark plugs immediately (raw gasoline sprays out of #2!). 2. Never force starter (can bend rod!). 3. Replace leaking injector #2 & change fuel-diluted oil!

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Torn Brake Booster Diaphragm Causing Massive Vacuum Leak!
phContext: Older sedans/MPVs; hissing under dash at brake pedal
symptoms: Engine stumbles/lean-codes whenever foot is OFF brake (or ON brake)
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clamp brake booster vacuum hose briefly at idle: rough idle smooths out & STFT drops from +25% to 0%! 2. Replace brake booster.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Single 10A STOP Fuse Blown by Shorted Tail/Third Brake Bulb!
phContext: Push-start AT vehicles (Vios, Xpander, City, Montero)
symptoms: Push-start won't crank, shifter locked in P, no brake lights
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 10A/15A STOP fuse! (Push-start & shift-lock both require brake light signal!). 2. Fix shorted bulb socket & replace fuse.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Single Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Cut by Road Debris!
phContext: Modern CAN vehicles (speedo, EPS, 4WD all depend on ABS wheel speed)
symptoms: 5 warning lights on, heavy steering, dead speedometer
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan ABS module to pinpoint exact failed wheel speed sensor (e.g., C0045 RL). 2. Repair cut sensor wire to clear all 5 systems!

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Radiator Internal ATF Cooler Burst — 'Strawberry Milkshake'!
phContext: AT SUVs/sedans with radiator-integrated ATF cooler
symptoms: Pink milkshake in radiator & ATF dipstick, transmission slips
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace radiator (or install external standalone ATF cooler!), flush cooling system 3x, and flush/rebuild transmission!

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Toyota 1KD-FTV Blow-By Past Copper Injector Seals -> Clogged Pickup!
phContext: 2005–2015 Hilux/Fortuner 3.0 D-4D
symptoms: Black chuffing from oil cap, oil light flickers hot, injector rattle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drop oil pan immediately to clean carbon chunks off oil pickup screen! 2. Replace all 4 injector copper seats/O-rings & clean EGR.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Loose Battery Terminal / Main Body Ground Over Bumps
phContext: Recently serviced cars; under-tightened negative clamp
symptoms: Car dies completely for 1 sec over lubak, clock resets
diagnosticSteps: 1. Twist both battery clamps by hand & check chassis ground bolt! 2. Clean & torque securely.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Multiple Heater/Sensor Open Codes — Single Blown 'ENG / INJ' Fuse!
phContext: Cars with 4+ unrelated sensor/solenoid codes all appearing together
symptoms: Sudden limp mode, 5+ open-circuit codes
diagnosticSteps: 1. Whenever 3+ unrelated 12V-fed components throw 'Circuit Low/Open' simultaneously, check their SHARED 10A/15A Engine Sensor Fuse FIRST! 2. Find which wire shorted.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Snapped Serpentine Belt (or Seized A/C Pulley Throwing Belt)!
phContext: Single-belt engines driving water pump + alternator + A/C
symptoms: Sudden battery light + heavy steering + rising temp + warm A/C!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull over immediately! Open hood to check serpentine belt and spin every pulley (A/C, alternator, idler, water pump) to find which seized!

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Head Gasket Seeping Coolant Into Cylinder #3 Overnight
phContext: Cars previously overheated; misfires ONLY for first 30 sec cold
symptoms: Rough cold start, sweet exhaust smell, slow coolant loss
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pressurize cooling system to 110 kPa cold overnight and borescope #3 cylinder in morning (green/pink coolant puddle on piston crown!). 2. Replace head gasket.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Diesel SCV Failing + Dirty Fuel Filter Combo
phContext: Hilux, Montero, D-Max, Navara
symptoms: RPM hunts at idle, dies stopping at red light
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace fuel filter + SCV together, clean tank strainer if dirty, and perform ECU Fuel Pump Learn!

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Broken Spiral Cable (Clock Spring) Ribbon!
phContext: Toyota, Honda, Mitsubishi, Hyundai
symptoms: 3 steering-wheel functions fail simultaneously
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace clock spring (center turns accurately & calibrate SAS!).

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Dead 12V Aux Battery Locking Out Healthy 400V HV Pack!
phContext: BYD, Toyota HEV, Nissan Kicks, MG4
symptoms: Car completely dead despite 80% HV charge
diagnosticSteps: 1. Jump-start 12V terminals to close HV contactors, check DC-DC output (14.2V), and replace weak 12V aux battery.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: GDI High-Pressure Fuel Pump Seal Leaking Gas Into Crankcase!
phContext: Honda 1.5T, Mazda Skyactiv, Hyundai GDI
symptoms: Dipstick oil thin & smells like gas, LTFT -20%
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace leaking cam-driven HPFP and change fuel-diluted oil immediately!

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Classic Thermal CKP Sensor Failure!
phContext: Hyundai Accent, Mitsubishi, Toyota, Honda
symptoms: Dies when hot in traffic, restarts after 20 min cool-down
diagnosticSteps: 1. Watch RPM PID while cranking hot (0 RPM = dead CKP!). 2. Replace OEM CKP sensor.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Flooded Kick-Panel BCM + Wet Under-Carpet CAN Splice!
phContext: Any sedan/MPV 2 weeks after driving through waist-deep typhoon flood
symptoms: Cascading body & starting gremlins
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull kick panels, carpets, and BCM; clean green verdigris off all harness connectors & dry/repair corroded splices!

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Split Silicone Boost Hose Cascading Into DPF Plug!
phContext: Euro-4+ CRDi pickups/vans
symptoms: Loss of power, black smoke, DPF light
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace split intercooler hose, clear codes, and run forced DPF regen.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Main ECM Relay / ECM Power Feed Open!
phContext: All EFI/CRDi cars; blown EFI Main Relay or IG1 fuse
symptoms: Engine cranks, fans roar full blast, scanner can't connect
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check EFI Main Relay & fuses; verify KL30/IG1/GND at ECM connector.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: CVT With Clogged Paper Cooler Filter & Degraded Fluid!
phContext: Mirage, Almera, Vios, City CVT
symptoms: Whines, shudders, enters thermal limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drop pan, replace internal strainer + external paper cartridge filter, and 2x flush with exact OEM CVTF.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Pothole Bent Tie-Rod Throwing Steering Angle Sensor Out!
phContext: City sedans/crossovers after deep lubak hit
symptoms: Wheel crooked 15°, ESC activates on curves
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace bent tie-rod/arm, align 4 wheels, and reset SAS zero-point!

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Open Alternator Sense (S) Fuse Causing 16V+ Overcharge!
phContext: Toyota, Nissan, Mitsubishi
symptoms: Rotten-egg smell, bulbs pop weekly
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 7.5A ALT-S fuse & wire before replacing alternator!

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: EVAP Purge Solenoid Stuck Wide Open!
phContext: Hyundai, Ford, Toyota, Honda
symptoms: Cranks 10 sec right after filling gas tank
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pinch EVAP purge hose at idle to confirm vacuum leak; replace purge valve.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Low Refrigerant (Not Blend Door!) Cooling Only Half of Evaporator!
phContext: Dual-zone SUVs/sedans
symptoms: Driver warm, passenger cold (or vice versa)
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check manifold A/C pressures FIRST before tearing dashboard apart! Leak-test & recharge.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Sulfated 12V Battery + Corroded Terminal Clamp!
phContext: All PH vehicles at 18–24 month battery age
symptoms: Rapid relay chatter, cascading U-codes
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean terminals, load-test & replace battery, clear U-codes.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Burst Rubber Oil Hose on Alternator-Mounted Vacuum Pump!
phContext: Toyota HiAce/Hilux, Mitsubishi 4D56, Isuzu
symptoms: Sudden oil leak + hard brake pedal
diagnosticSteps: 1. Shut engine off immediately! Replace burst high-temp oil hose on vacuum pump.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Cracked Exhaust Manifold / Flex Pipe Sucking Air Into O2 Sensor!
phContext: Front-wheel-drive sedans hitting speed bumps
symptoms: False lean trim + false cat fault
diagnosticSteps: 1. Weld cracked exhaust flex-pipe/manifold gasket BEFORE condemning O2 or catalytic converter!

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Broken Rear Differential / Wheel Speed Sensor Wire!
phContext: 4x4 pickups/SUVs
symptoms: 4WD & ABS disabled together
diagnosticSteps: 1. Fix broken wheel speed sensor wire; 4WD & cruise restore automatically.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Botched Aftermarket Radio / Fan Backfeeding IG1 Circuit!
phContext: Cars with recent DIY electrical work
symptoms: Engine stays running 3 sec key-off, battery dead next day
diagnosticSteps: 1. Isolate backfeeding aftermarket relay/radio onto true switched ACC/IG1.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Floodwater Silt in Accelerator Pedal (APP) Connector!
phContext: Sedans/pickups driven in deep cabin flood
symptoms: Idles at 1200 RPM, zero gas pedal response
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean/dry 6-pin pedal connector or replace corroded APP assembly.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Collapsed Hydraulic Engine Mount + Torn Transmission Mount!
phContext: Honda City/Civic, Toyota Vios, Mitsubishi
symptoms: Cabin shakes at stoplight, smooths out in Neutral
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace collapsed right hydraulic engine mount & rear torque mount.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Failing In-Tank Fuel Pump Overheating in Hot Traffic!
phContext: High-mileage taxis/cars running <1/4 tank
symptoms: Dies after 45 min in traffic, starts fine after cooling
diagnosticSteps: 1. Monitor fuel pressure & pump current draw hot; replace pump & clean tank sock.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: City-Bound Euro-4+ Diesel Diluting Oil With Failed Regens!
phContext: Hilux/Fortuner/Ranger/PU V stuck in crawling traffic
symptoms: Oil above F mark, DPF flashing, limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Change diesel-diluted oil FIRST, fix any EGT/thermostat/boost fault, then run service DPF regen!

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Corroded Main Chassis Ground Strap!
phContext: Older cars/trucks
symptoms: Slow crank, dim lights, gauges jump when wipers run
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure voltage drop from battery (-) to engine & body (<0.2V); replace ground strap.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Worn Inner CV Tripod Joint (Not Tire Balance!)
phContext: FWD cars & lifted 4x4s
symptoms: Side-to-side wobble ONLY while pressing gas
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect inner CV cups for play; replace worn CV axle.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Warped Brake Rotors + Torn Lower Control Arm Bushings!
phContext: SUVs/sedans on rough roads
symptoms: Steering shudders braking from 90 km/h
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace BOTH warped rotors AND torn control arm bushings so vibration doesn't return!

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Overdue Oil Changes Starving & Jamming VVT-i OCV Screen!
phContext: Toyota/Honda/Hyundai VVT engines
symptoms: Rattle on cold start, stalls at idle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean VVT OCV filter screen, flush oil sludge, and switch to 5W-30 synthetic every 5,000–7,500 km.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Corroded Transmission Range (Inhibitor) Switch!
phContext: AT/CVT cars after flood crossing
symptoms: Blank gear display, won't crank in P, no reverse lamps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean/replace & align PRNDL range switch on transmission side.

domainName: Multi-Symptom Complex Case Studies & Differential Diagnosis Matrices
title: Systematic 5-Step Isolation Protocol (Power -> Ground -> Comm -> Fuel -> Spark)
phContext: Elusive intermittent PH vehicle faults
symptoms: Customer stranded randomly, fine at shop
diagnosticSteps: 1. Never guess parts! Log Freeze-Frame, wiggle-test harnesses while scoping 5V/CKP/Fuel/Ignition, load-test battery/grounds, and verify under real PH traffic heat load.
